papers.title: ACAP: Asynchronous Coding Agents for Efficient Robot Control
papers.abstract: Abstract  Coding agents can construct and revise robot behavior during execution, but using one agent for the whole robot can delay otherwise independent work. We introduce Asynchronous Coding Agents as Policy (ACAP), an asynchronous framework that organizes one robot as a team of persistent agents. Each member reasons and acts for a configurable control group, such as an arm with its gripper or the torso and chassis, enabling asynchronous reasoning and execution. However, different robot components often have physical dependencies that require coordination. To address this challenge, ACAP introduces a hyper-agent that assigns tasks, coordinates dependencies, and dynamically allocates control between the lead and member agents. This allows independent work to progress concurrently while supporting tightly coupled manipulation when necessary. Across 72 real-world rollouts covering 25 task/platform settings, ACAP reduces task-balanced time cost by 28.2% compared with a single-agent Direct Policy, with improvements across Fully Parallel, Parallel-Sequential, and Collaborative tasks. Across all eight Collaborative settings, ACAP also achieves lower mean time cost than Fixed Delegation, where only member agents can control their assigned groups. An additional 90-rollout study shows lower mean 30-minute-capped time cost than Direct on all six tasks. We further demonstrate mobile manipulation using the same member interface for chassis and torso control. We present the framework and a real-world rollout dataset containing observations, generated programs, actions, and feedback to support research on how coding agents reason and act in the physical world.

ru.title: Команда агентов быстрее одного робота: асинхронное кодирование движений
ru.desc: Статья представляет ACAP — асинхронный фреймворк, в котором управление роботом строится как команда постоянных LLM-агентов, каждый из которых отвечает за свою группу звеньев, например манипулятор с захватом или торс и шасси. Для учёта физических зависимостей между компонентами вводится hyper-agent, который распределяет задачи, координирует взаимосвязи и динамически передаёт контроль между ведущим и вспомогательными агентами. По результатам 72 реальных запусков время выполнения задач сократилось на 28,2% по сравнению с одноагентной Direct Policy, а также подход показал преимущества над Fixed Delegation. Авторы также публикуют датасет реальных запусков с наблюдениями, сгенерированными программами, действиями и обратной связью.

en.title: Many Agents, One Robot: Work in Parallel, Coordinate When It Counts
en.desc: ACAP is an asynchronous framework that uses persistent coding agents to control different groups of a robot, such as its arm or chassis. A hyper-agent assigns tasks, manages physical dependencies, and shifts control between the lead agent and member agents when coordination is needed. This lets independent robot actions happen concurrently while supporting coordinated manipulation. In real-world trials, ACAP reduced task time compared with single-agent control and fixed delegation, and the authors provide a dataset of robot observations, programs, actions, and feedback.

zh.title: 多智能体异步协作，让机器人并行行动又能默契配合
zh.desc: 本文提出异步编码智能体策略（ACAP），让多个长期运行的智能体分别负责机器人的不同控制组，并行推理与执行。由于机器人部件之间可能存在物理依赖，ACAP 使用一个超智能体分配任务、协调依赖关系，并动态调整主智能体与成员智能体的控制权。真实机器人实验表明，与单智能体直接策略相比，ACAP 的任务平衡时间成本降低了 28.2%，在协作任务中也优于固定分工方法。研究还展示了移动操作能力，并发布包含观测、生成程序、动作和反馈的数据集，以支持对实体环境中智能体行为的研究。

papers.title: Rewirable Circuits in Transformers with Loom Attention
papers.abstract: Abstract  We propose loom attention, which allows a Transformer to dynamically rewire its circuits at every token by interweaving a head's vertical attention over the outputs of earlier heads (to obtain its query, key and value) with its horizontal attention over tokens. We instantiate vertical attention efficiently with normalized and gated linear attention over a per-token matrix memory, which stores the compressed head outputs and serves as a second residual stream. This yields LoomFormer, a dual-stream architecture that splits control and content between the vector and matrix streams. Across model sizes and training token budgets in language modeling and downstream tasks, LoomFormer matches Transformers trained with over 3x compute and recent residual-stream baselines (HC/mHC, MUDDFormer, AttnRes) trained with ~1.7-2.8x. For example, trained on the same 300B tokens with only 2% extra FLOPs, LoomPythia-2.8B achieves ~1.6x the average downstream gain of mHC-Pythia-2.8B over Pythia-2.8B, and matches (0-shot) or surpasses (5-shot) Pythia-12B. Code is available at https://github.com/Caiyun-AI/LoomFormer
affiliations: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

ru.title: Динамическая перекройка внимания: контроль и содержимое в двух потоках
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают механизм loom attention, который позволяет Transformer динамически перестраивать свои внутренние связи на каждом токене. Вертикальное внимание над выходами предыдущих голов сочетается с горизонтальным вниманием по токенам, а вертикальная часть реализуется через нормализованный gated linear attention над матричной памятью для каждого токена. Так получается архитектура LoomFormer с двумя потоками: векторным, отвечающим за контроль, и матричным, хранящим содержимое. По результатам экспериментов в языковом моделировании и downstream-задачах LoomFormer сопоставим с Transformer, обученными на существенно большем объёме вычислений, и превосходит residual-stream baselines, например LoomPythia-2.8B почти в 1.6 раза опережает mHC-Pythia-2.8B по среднему приросту.

en.title: Weaving a second stream into Transformer attention
en.desc: The paper introduces loom attention, which lets each Transformer head dynamically use outputs from earlier heads while also attending across tokens. It implements this with gated linear attention and a per-token matrix memory, creating a second stream alongside the usual vector residual stream. The resulting LoomFormer separates control and content across these two streams and performs strongly on language modeling and downstream tasks. In experiments, it matches or exceeds several larger or more compute-intensive models, including outperforming a baseline trained on the same token budget with only a small increase in FLOPs.

zh.title: 让注意力头动态编织信息，以更少计算获得更强表现
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出 Loom Attention，让 Transformer 在处理每个词元时，都能动态调整不同注意力头之间的信息连接。它通过垂直注意力读取先前注意力头的输出，并结合通常在词元之间进行的水平注意力；垂直注意力使用带归一化和门控的线性注意力，以及保存压缩头输出的矩阵记忆来高效实现。基于此，LoomFormer 将信息分为向量流和矩阵流，分别承担控制与内容表示。在语言建模和下游任务实验中，它以较少计算量取得了有竞争力的效果，例如 LoomPythia-2.8B 在相同训练词元数量下显著提升下游表现，并在部分评测中达到或超过 Pythia-12B。

papers.title: S-Mind: Internalizing Multi-View Geometry for Spatial Intelligence
papers.abstract: Abstract  Spatial intelligence, the ability to reason about 3D space from visual observations, becomes essential as multimodal large language models (MLLMs) move into the physical world. Beyond perceiving each view, it rests on two cornerstones of human cognition: fusing multiple views into one coherent 3D scene and mentally transforming that scene to new viewpoints as reasoning unfolds. Yet our spatial probes reveal that MLLMs largely lack both capabilities, even after spatial fine-tuning. We therefore present S-Mind, which internalizes multi-view geometry within the MLLM through a compact set of spatial tokens. It supervises these tokens to hold the fused 3D scene and re-emits them to re-express this scene from every viewpoint the reasoning adopts. Across four spatial benchmarks, S-Mind improves its Qwen3.5 backbones by up to 22.26 points and surpasses frontier general models such as GPT-6-Astra (+0.45), Kimi-K3.1-Pro (+1.97), and GLM-5.3-Flash (+7.80) in average accuracy. Moreover, the same probes confirm that it acquires both capabilities, reaching fusion and transformation accuracies of 65.11% and 82.17%, against at most 16.02% and 37.28% for the baselines. At inference, S-Mind also runs about 100x faster than a tool-based agent on the same backbone. Instilled through these spatial tokens during training, spatial capability becomes intrinsic to the backbone and persists even when the tokens are withheld, offering a promising path toward spatial intelligence in MLLMs.
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

ru.title: Пространственный разум внутри модели: видеть сцену целиком и смотреть на неё с любой стороны
ru.desc: Статья представляет S-Mind — подход, который встраивает геометрию нескольких ракурсов непосредственно в мультимодальную LLM с помощью компактного набора пространственных токенов. Эти токены обучаются хранить объединённую 3D-сцену и заново выражать её с любой точки зрения, которую выбирает рассуждение модели. Эксперименты на четырёх пространственных бенчмарках показывают рост точности до 22,26 пункта для backbone Qwen3.5 и превосходство над несколькими передовыми general-моделями, при этом инференс примерно в 100 раз быстрее tool-based агента. Пространственные способности закрепляются в весах модели и сохраняются даже без использования токенов.

en.title: Teach models to build and rethink a 3D world
en.desc: The paper introduces S-Mind, a method that helps multimodal large language models reason about 3D space. It uses compact spatial tokens to combine multiple visual views into a coherent 3D scene and represent that scene from new viewpoints during reasoning. On four benchmarks, S-Mind improves its underlying models and outperforms several general-purpose models, while running much faster than a tool-based agent. The results suggest that training with spatial tokens can make multi-view fusion and viewpoint transformation intrinsic capabilities that remain even when the tokens are not used at inference time.

zh.title: 用空间 token 让模型看懂三维世界
zh.desc: 论文提出了 S-Mind，旨在让多模态大语言模型具备更强的三维空间推理能力。它通过一组紧凑的空间 token 来融合多视角信息，形成连贯的三维场景表示，并能根据推理需要从新的视角重新表达场景。实验显示，S-Mind 在四项空间基准测试中提升了模型表现，也显著增强了多视角融合与视角变换能力。训练得到的空间能力即使在推理时不提供这些 token 也能保留，而且运行速度比基于工具的智能体快约 100 倍。

papers.title: PartAgent: Agentic 3D Part Segmentation via Expert Integration and Closed-Loop Refinement
papers.abstract: Abstract A training-free agentic framework integrates pretrained 3D and 2D experts with closed-loop refinement to achieve state-of-the-art 3D part segmentation across multiple benchmarks.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Segmenting a 3D object into semantically meaningful parts requires joint reasoning about geometric structure and semantic context. Pretrained 3D experts provide spatially grounded region proposals, while 2D experts provide semantic cues for identifying object parts. The challenge is to integrate these complementary capabilities into a framework that can both produce meaningful part segmentations and progressively refine them. We present PartAgent, a training-free agentic framework for 3D part segmentation built upon two complementary modules: (i) Structural-Semantic Expert Integration combines regions predicted by the 3D expert with multiview semantic evidence from the 2D expert through image-to-surface correspondences, constructing compositional part partitions at multiple granularities. (ii) Observation-Driven Closed-Loop Partition Refinement observes the current partition and its supporting evidence to select targeted inspection, evidence repair, composition, or reselection actions. It verifies proposed changes and uses the updated state and action outcomes to guide subsequent decisions. On PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT, PartAgent achieves 68.41 mIoU, outperforming the strongest competing method by 8.53 points. Across 3DCoMPaT200, PartNeXt, PartNetE, and PartObjaverse-Tiny, PartAgent achieves the highest mIoU on each dataset, averaging 69.36 across the four datasets, 7.28 points above the highest mean among competing methods.
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

ru.title: Агент, который собирает и уточняет части 3D-объекта без обучения
ru.desc: Статья представляет PartAgent — агентную систему для сегментации 3D-объектов на части без дополнительного обучения (training-free). Она объединяет предобученного 3D-эксперта, который выдаёт пространственно привязанные регионы, и 2D-эксперта (vision-language модель), дающего семантические признаки по нескольким ракурсам, с помощью соответствий между изображением и поверхностью. Модуль замкнутого цикла уточнения анализирует текущее разбиение и выбирает действия: проверку, исправление доказательств, композицию или переотбор, после чего проверяет изменения и учитывает их результаты. На нескольких бенчмарках, включая PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT, PartAgent показывает наилучший mIoU, в среднем на 7.28 пункта выше лучших конкурирующих методов.

en.title: Combine 2D Meaning with 3D Structure—Then Refine in a Loop
en.desc: PartAgent segments 3D objects into meaningful parts by combining pretrained 3D region proposals with semantic cues from pretrained 2D models. It connects multiview image predictions to 3D surfaces to build part partitions at different levels of detail. In a closed loop, the agent inspects its current segmentation, chooses actions such as repairing evidence or recomposing parts, and checks whether each change improves the result. It achieves the highest reported mean intersection over union (mIoU) among the compared methods across several benchmarks, without additional training.

zh.title: 融合 2D 语义与 3D 结构，让部件分割持续精进
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出了 PartAgent，一个无需额外训练的 3D 部件分割框架。它结合 3D 专家的空间区域建议与 2D 专家的多视角语义信息，并通过图像到 3D 表面的对应关系生成不同粒度的部件划分。框架还会观察当前分割结果，按需检查或修复证据、组合区域或重新选择，并验证修改效果以逐步改进结果。在多个基准数据集上，PartAgent 的平均 mIoU 达到 69.36，优于现有对比方法。

papers.title: Antom 3-in-1 Transformer: A Payment Foundation Model
papers.abstract: Abstract  We report the development of Antom 3-in-1 Transformer, a payment foundation model that integrates sequence, tabular, and graph representations for payment risk detection. The model contains approximately 7B parameters, with approximately 1.7B activated per task route. Antom 3-in-1 Transformer is pretrained to learn reusable behavioral and relational representations, primarily on Ant International's internal payment data. In a cross-business transfer experiment, pretraining improves the target business metric by 34.5% over the same architecture trained from scratch. With only 25% of the training labels, the pretrained model outperforms the full-label scratch baseline in Average Precision (AP) and Recall@0.5% on different merchant domains. In a four-month online experiment on Ant International's billion-scale payment platform, the model reduced the overall loss rate by 37.88% relative to XGB-Online.

ru.title: Одна предобученная модель защищает платежи лучше, чем обучение с нуля
ru.desc: Авторы представляют Antom 3-in-1 Transformer — foundation model для платежей примерно на 7B параметров, которая объединяет sequence, tabular и graph representations для детекции платежных рисков. Модель предобучается на внутренних платежных данных Ant International, чтобы выучить переиспользуемые поведенческие и relational embeddings. При переносе между бизнесами pretraining даёт прирост целевой метрики на 34.5% по сравнению с обучением той же архитектуры с нуля, а при использовании лишь 25% разметки модель превосходит baseline на полной выборке по AP и Recall@0.5%. В четырехмесячном онлайн-эксперименте на платформе масштаба миллиардов платежей общий уровень потерь снизился на 37.88% относительно XGB-Online.

en.title: One foundation model for payment risk across data types
en.desc: Antom 3-in-1 Transformer is a payment foundation model that combines sequence, tabular, and graph representations to detect payment risks. With about 7 billion parameters, it is pretrained mainly on Ant International’s payment data to learn reusable behavioral and relational patterns. In experiments, pretraining improved performance on a new business by 34.5%, and with only 25% of the labels, the model exceeded a scratch-trained baseline on Average Precision and Recall@0.5%. A four-month online trial on a billion-scale platform reduced the overall loss rate by 37.88% compared with XGB-Online.

zh.title: 融合序列、表格与图，让支付风险识别更精准
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出 Antom 3-in-1 Transformer，一种用于支付风险检测的基础模型，可联合处理序列、表格和图结构数据。模型约有 70 亿个参数，并通过不同任务路由激活约 17 亿个参数；它主要利用蚂蚁国际的内部支付数据进行预训练，以学习可复用的行为与关系表示。在跨业务迁移实验中，预训练使目标业务指标比从头训练提升 34.5%；仅使用四分之一的训练标签时，模型在不同商户领域的平均精确率（AP）和 Recall@0.5% 上也优于使用完整标签从头训练的基线。为期四个月的线上实验显示，在十亿规模的支付平台上，该模型相较于 XGB-Online 将整体损失率降低了 37.88%。

papers.title: KMed-31B Technical Report
papers.abstract: Abstract  We present KMed-31B, a medical large language model post-trained from an open-weight model for on-premises deployment with limited hardware. Post-training a model for diverse medical tasks remains difficult, because improving one kind of task can lower performance on another. We attribute this to differences between tasks in expected output and available feedback. Medical question answering and diagnosis prediction have reference answers, whereas clinical inquiry has no single correct response and is judged with rubrics. We therefore divide medical training tasks into four categories by these two properties, train one specialist per category with a reward that its feedback supports, and integrate the specialists into a single student with Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation (MOPD^2). For clinical inquiry, we build Synthetic Health Dialogue, a simulated corpus of consultations with lay users and clinicians whose patient cases span common clinical presentations in primary care. Relative to its base model, KMed-31B raises HealthBench Hard from 22.95 to 41.87 and HealthBench Professional from 37.92 to 50.20 in non-thinking mode, and from 23.80 to 51.48 and from 41.97 to 59.18 in thinking mode, while its scores on four multiple-choice medical benchmarks are maintained or slightly improved. KMed-31B has the highest unadjusted HealthBench Hard score among the compared models, including proprietary ones, and scores higher on HealthBench Professional than every open-weight model we compare, including models with more than ten times as many total parameters. Applied to another base model, Qwen3.8-27B, the same training recipe also raises both HealthBench scores. We describe the training recipe, data construction, and settings in detail so that institutions requiring on-premises deployment can develop medical models from open-weight foundations.

ru.title: Медицинская LLM, которая учится без потери качества и работает у вас дома
ru.desc: Авторы представляют KMed-31B — медицинскую LLM, дообученную на открытой модели для работы on-premises на ограниченном железе. Медицинские задачи делятся на четыре категории по типу ожидаемого ответа и обратной связи, и для каждой обучается отдельный specialist-модель с подходящим reward. Знания специалистов объединяются в единого student через метод MOPD^2 (Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation), а для задач клинического опроса создан синтетический корпус Synthetic Health Dialogue. Модель заметно улучшает результаты на HealthBench Hard и HealthBench Professional, сохраняя качество на тестах с вариантами ответов, и превосходит многие открытые модели, включая те, что крупнее в десятки раз.

en.title: Four medical specialists, one stronger model
en.desc: KMed-31B is an open-weight medical language model designed to run on local hardware. To handle different kinds of medical tasks, the researchers trained four specialists with rewards suited to each task category, then combined them into one model using Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation. They also created simulated health dialogues to train the model for clinical conversations, where answers are judged by rubrics rather than a single reference answer. KMed-31B improved scores on two clinical benchmarks while maintaining or slightly improving performance on four multiple-choice medical benchmarks.

zh.title: 专才协同蒸馏，让医疗模型在有限硬件上更强更可靠
zh.desc: 本文介绍了 KMed-31B，这是一个从开放权重模型后训练而成、适合在硬件资源有限的机构内部部署的医疗大语言模型。为减少不同医疗任务之间的性能冲突，研究者根据任务的输出形式和反馈方式，将任务分为四类，分别训练专长模型，再用多教师在线策略增量蒸馏（MOPD²）整合成一个学生模型。对于没有标准答案的临床问诊任务，他们还构建了模拟患者与临床医生对话的合成数据集 Synthetic Health Dialogue。实验显示，KMed-31B 显著提升了 HealthBench 评分，同时保持或略微改善了四项医疗选择题基准的表现；相同训练方案用于另一基础模型时也有效。

papers.title: PhyCoVE: Benchmarking Physical Counterfactual Video Editing across Diverse Material Dynamics
papers.abstract: Abstract PhyCoVE, a 533-case benchmark, and counterfactual fidelity evaluate video editing models on physical counterfactual edits involving rigid, elastic, and fluid dynamics, showing that even the best model reproduces only about one seventh of the physical change.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Physical counterfactual video editing turns a source video and a language-specified physical edit at a given execution frame into a counterfactual video that shows how the scene would evolve after the edit. Existing evaluations with counterfactual target videos mainly cover object removal or specific rigid-body motions, although real scenes also involve elastic deformation, fluid flow, and interactions among rigid bodies, elastic solids, and fluids. We introduce PhyCoVE, a benchmark of 533 cases on 110 source videos that covers rigid, elastic, and fluid dynamics in five interaction patterns, with edits that remove an object, change a physical quantity, or insert a new object. For the simulated cases, a language model proposes scene designs, coding agents build them with solvers suited to each material and physically based rendering and then simulate each edit from the source scene state, and humans check every stage. For the real cases, we record continuously from one camera position before and after each edit. We also propose counterfactual fidelity, a metric that applies across materials and their interactions and measures how much of the physical change from the source video to the target video a generated video reproduces. We evaluate seven open-source and commercial video editing models and find that counterfactual fidelity ranks them nearly as human preference does, but even the best model reproduces only about one seventh of the physical change. The models change how a scene looks but rarely how it evolves, whereas a physical edit requires understanding the dynamics that it changes. Physical counterfactual video editing thus remains far from solved, and PhyCoVE provides a foundation for developing and evaluating methods for it.
affiliations: Institute of Trustworthy Embodied AI, Fudan University

ru.title: Видео-модели меняют внешний вид сцены, но не её физику
ru.desc: Статья представляет PhyCoVE — бенчмарк из 533 кейсов на 110 исходных видео для оценки моделей физического контрфактического редактирования видео, охватывающих твёрдые тела, эластичные материалы и жидкости. Данные созданы комбинированным способом: симуляции, построенные LLM и кодирующими агентами с проверкой людьми, и реальные записи с одной камеры до и после правки. Авторы вводят метрику counterfactual fidelity, которая измеряет долю физического изменения, воспроизведённую сгенерированным видео. Оценка семи моделей показала, что даже лучшая воспроизводит лишь около одной седьмой физического изменения, так как модели меняют внешний вид сцены, но плохо передают её динамику.

en.title: Editing the Look Isn’t Enough: Video Models Must Change the Physics
en.desc: The paper introduces PhyCoVE, a benchmark of 533 cases for testing video editing models on physical changes involving rigid objects, elastic materials, and fluids. It also proposes counterfactual fidelity, a metric that measures how much of the physical change in a target video an edited video reproduces. Tests of seven video editing models show that this metric ranks models similarly to human preferences, but even the best model reproduces only about one seventh of the physical change. The results suggest that current models can alter a scene’s appearance but struggle to simulate how it evolves after a physical edit.

zh.title: 让视频真正改变物理演变，而不只是改变画面
zh.desc: 本文提出 PhyCoVE，这是一个包含 533 个案例的视频编辑基准，覆盖刚体、弹性体和流体动力学，以及多种物体交互。任务是根据文字指令和指定执行时刻修改源视频中的物理条件，并生成编辑后场景的演变过程。研究还提出“反事实保真度”指标，用来衡量生成视频复现目标物理变化的程度；该指标对不同材料和交互都适用，其模型排名与人类偏好大致一致。对七种视频编辑模型的评测显示，最佳模型也只复现了约七分之一的物理变化，说明现有模型往往改变画面外观，却难以准确生成物理过程。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Evaluation Environments for Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract CUA-SEE is a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers to adaptively measure computer-use agents’ capabilities, boundaries, and progress reliability.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet their evaluation remains largely static. Existing benchmarks provide a strong foundation, but fixed difficulty ceilings, limited feature coverage, and coarse aggregate scores progressively weaken their discriminative and diagnostic value. We introduce CUA-SEE, a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers from rollout evidence. It disentangles three objectives: benchmark evolution expands evaluation scope through cohort-calibrated difficulty and coverage growth; diagnostic evolution increases resolution through agent-conditional capability-boundary probes; and verifier evolution improves precision by translating changing requirements into state-grounded checkpoints with adversarial validation. Across multiple agents, applications, and rounds, CUA-SEE generates challenging, measurable tasks while preserving process-level evidence. Our results position adaptive evaluation as a scalable counterpart to self-evolving agents, continuously tracking what agents can do, where their boundaries lie, and how reliably progress is measured.

ru.title: Оценивать агентов так же адаптивно, как они сами учатся
ru.desc: CUA-SEE — это закрытая (closed-loop) среда оценки, которая динамически развивает задачи и исполняемые верификаторы на основе данных прогонов агентов. Статическим бенчмаркам свойственны фиксированный потолок сложности, ограниченное покрытие функций и грубые агрегированные метрики, что снижает их диагностическую ценность. Авторы разделяют три процесса: эволюцию бенчмарка (расширение охвата за счёт калибровки сложности), диагностическую эволюцию (зондирование границ возможностей конкретного агента) и эволюцию верификаторов (повышение точности через проверку состояний с адверсариальной валидацией). Результаты показывают, что адаптивная оценка может стать масштабируемым аналогом самоэволюционирующих агентов, непрерывно отслеживая возможности и надёжность computer-use агентов.

en.title: Evolving Benchmarks for Evolving Computer-Use Agents
en.desc: CUA-SEE is a closed-loop evaluation system that updates tasks and executable verifiers using evidence from agent runs. Its benchmark evolution expands task coverage and adjusts difficulty, while diagnostic evolution creates probes to identify each agent’s capability boundaries. Verifier evolution turns changing task requirements into state-grounded checkpoints and tests them against adversarial cases to improve measurement precision. Across agents, applications, and evaluation rounds, the system produces challenging tasks and tracks capabilities, limitations, and progress with process-level evidence.

zh.title: 让评测与智能体共同进化，持续看清能力边界
zh.desc: CUA-SEE 是一种闭环评测环境，会根据智能体执行任务时产生的证据，持续更新任务和可执行验证器。它从三个方面改进评测：扩展基准的任务范围与难度，针对不同智能体设计能力边界探测，并用基于实际状态的检查点提升验证准确度。该方法还通过对抗性验证检查评测标准是否可靠，并保留任务执行过程中的证据。实验表明，CUA-SEE 能持续追踪计算机使用智能体的能力、局限及其进步是否被可靠测量。

papers.title: LeadVLA: Learning Follower-Aware Route Execution for Robot Leading
papers.abstract: Abstract LeadVLA is a structured multimodal policy that separates route execution into explicit path, pace, and residual components, trained and evaluated with generated closed-loop data and a benchmark, achieving the highest success among tested robot policies and transferring to unseen real environments without fine-tuning.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Robot leading requires executing a route while continuously adapting to a designated follower. Existing robot-leading systems often mediate follower understanding and physical route execution through explicit states, planners, or modular interfaces; directly learning this coupling through end-to-end trajectory prediction can instead entangle route execution with follower response. We introduce LeadVLA, a structured multimodal policy that preserves the route as an explicit Path reference while learning a Pace for route progress and a Residual for local follower- and scene-conditioned adaptation. To make this problem trainable and measurable, we develop LeadInfra, a configurable Unreal Engine-based closed-loop data-generation infrastructure from which we instantiate an approximately 4M-sample training corpus, and LeadBench, a standardized benchmark with 108 fully held-out closed-loop episodes. LeadVLA achieves the highest task success (39.6%) among evaluated robot policies on LeadBench while maintaining strong route fidelity and follower responsiveness, and transfers to unseen real-world environments without real-world policy fine-tuning. Project Page: https://louiszengCN.github.io/LeadVLA_PAGE/
affiliations: Southern University of Science and Technology

ru.title: Робот ведёт за собой: маршрут, темп и адаптация — раздельно и точно
ru.desc: Статья представляет LeadVLA — структурированную мультимодальную политику (policy) для робота-проводника, который ведёт за собой следующего за ним человека или робота. Модель разделяет управление на три явные части: Path (маршрут), Pace (темп движения по маршруту) и Residual (локальная поправка с учётом поведения последователя и сцены). Для обучения и оценки авторы создали LeadInfra — конфигурируемую инфраструктуру генерации closed-loop данных на базе Unreal Engine (около 4M обучающих примеров) и бенчмарк LeadBench из 108 полностью отложенных эпизодов. LeadVLA достигает наивысшего показателя успешности (39.6%) среди протестированных политик и работает в новых реальных средах без дообучения (fine-tuning) на реальных данных.

en.title: Keep the route clear, adapt the pace
en.desc: LeadVLA is a multimodal robot policy for guiding a follower along a route. It separates behavior into an explicit path reference, a pace for controlling route progress, and a residual for adapting to the follower and surroundings. The researchers trained it using about four million simulated examples and evaluated it on 108 held-out closed-loop episodes. It achieved the highest success rate among the tested policies and transferred to unfamiliar real environments without fine-tuning on real-world data.

zh.title: 路径明确、步调灵活，让机器人带路更可靠
zh.desc: 论文提出 LeadVLA，一种用于机器人引导任务的结构化多模态策略。它将路线执行拆分为显式路径（Path）、路线进度控制（Pace）和局部残差调整（Residual），以便机器人既能遵循路线，也能根据跟随者和场景变化灵活适应。研究还构建了闭环数据生成基础设施 LeadInfra，并据此生成约 400 万条训练样本，同时建立包含 108 个留出回合的标准基准 LeadBench。LeadVLA 在测试的机器人策略中取得最高任务成功率 39.6%，并能迁移到未见过的真实环境中，无需使用真实世界数据进行策略微调。

papers.title: RoomTokens: Masked Diffusion over Structured Tokens for Indoor Scene Synthesis
papers.abstract: Abstract  Generating 3D indoor scenes requires a representation that captures object semantics, instance identity, height structure, and orientation while respecting room geometry. Methods that model scenes as sequences of object vectors learn spatial constraints implicitly, leaving collisions and boundary violations to losses or post-processing; semantic-map methods make occupancy explicit, but collapse instance and directional structure. We introduce RoomTokens, a sliced structured-token representation in which each token stores semantic class, instance-color identity, and facing field. This representation allows a scene to be generated as a discrete grid while preserving cues for instance grouping, orientation estimation, and 3D extent prediction. To learn the RoomToken distribution, we propose MDIRT (Masked Diffusion over RoomTokens), a masked discrete diffusion model that denoises semantic/instance-color/facing channels jointly with a shared cross-slice backbone. Architectural tokens are clamped as explicit floor- plan constraints, so the model samples furniture layouts that respect room geometry while retaining instance and object-attribute structure. Experiments on 3D-FRONT show that RoomTokens with MDIRT improve layout fidelity and physical consistency over sequence/vector- and map-based methods, suggesting structured spatial tokens as a practical choice for discrete 3D scene synthesis.

ru.title: Структурированные токены делают генерацию 3D-интерьеров геометрически верной
ru.desc: Статья предлагает RoomTokens — структурированное токенное представление 3D-сцены интерьера в виде дискретной сетки, где каждый токен хранит семантический класс, цвет-идентификатор экземпляра и поле направления. Для генерации этих токенов авторы вводят MDIRT, маскированную дискретную диффузионную модель (masked discrete diffusion), которая совместно деноизирует все каналы через общий cross-slice backbone. Архитектурные элементы фиксируются как явные ограничения планировки, поэтому модель генерирует расстановку мебели, соблюдающую геометрию комнаты. Эксперименты на датасете 3D-FRONT показывают, что такой подход улучшает точность компоновки и физическую согласованность по сравнению с методами на основе последовательностей векторов и карт.

en.title: RoomTokens: Diffusion that builds 3D rooms with structure
en.desc: The paper introduces RoomTokens, a grid-based representation for 3D indoor scenes that records each object’s semantic class, instance identity, and facing direction. It uses MDIRT, a masked discrete diffusion model, to jointly generate and refine these token channels across room slices. Architectural constraints such as walls and floor plans are fixed during generation, helping layouts fit the room while preserving object structure and orientation. Tests on 3D-FRONT show better layout fidelity and physical consistency than sequence-based and semantic-map approaches.

zh.title: 用结构化空间标记生成更合理的室内场景
zh.desc: 论文提出 RoomTokens，用结构化的网格标记表示室内场景中的物体类别、实例身份和朝向，并保留物体的高度与空间信息。研究还提出 MDIRT，一种掩码离散扩散模型，可联合学习这些标记并逐步生成场景布局。生成时，模型将房间的墙壁和地面等结构作为固定约束，帮助家具布局符合房间几何形状。3D-FRONT 实验表明，这种方法比序列向量和语义地图类方法生成的布局更贴合目标，也更符合物理规律。

papers.title: MAGPIE: Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation via Executable Scene Construction
papers.abstract: Abstract  Multi-reference image generation requires a model to preserve the appearance of selected subjects while arranging them according to an instruction. Despite recent progress in reference-based generation and compositional control, reliably organizing selected subjects into the intended scene remains challenging. Although existing methods provide various forms of compositional guidance, the planned relationships are not always explicitly instantiated for inspection and refinement before image synthesis. To address this limitation, we introduce MAGPIE, which represents the intended composition as a simplified 3D scene defined by an executable Blender program. A coding agent links each scene instance to its reference, checks the geometry and rendered view against the instruction, and revises the program to correct discrepancies. The final proxy rendering serves as a visual plan for the image generator. Using MAGPIE-Instruct-3K, we train the generator to follow this plan while drawing each subject's appearance from its reference. MAGPIE improves both Qwen and FLUX on DreamOmni2 and SconeEval. With FLUX, it improves overall success on DreamOmni2 by 28.21 percentage points over the original backbone and achieves the highest overall score among the models evaluated on SconeEval.

ru.title: Сначала план в 3D, потом картинка
ru.desc: Статья представляет MAGPIE, метод генерации изображений по нескольким эталонным объектам, который сохраняет внешний вид субъектов и организует их сцену по инструкции. Композиция сначала задаётся упрощённой 3D-сценой в виде исполняемой Blender-программы, а агент-кодер (coding agent) проверяет геометрию и рендер и исправляет программу. Полученный прокси-рендер служит визуальным планом для генератора, который обучается на датасете MAGPIE-Instruct-3K. Метод улучшает модели Qwen и FLUX на бенчмарках DreamOmni2 и SconeEval, давая для FLUX прирост успешности на 28.21 процентных пункта.

en.title: Plan the scene in 3D, then generate it from references
en.desc: MAGPIE helps image-generation models place selected subjects into a scene while keeping their appearance consistent with reference images. It turns the instruction into a simple 3D scene described by an executable Blender program, then checks and revises the scene before image synthesis. The rendered scene acts as a visual plan, and the generator is trained on MAGPIE-Instruct-3K to follow that plan while drawing each subject’s appearance from its reference. Tests show that MAGPIE improves Qwen and FLUX on DreamOmni2 and SconeEval, including a 28.21 percentage-point gain for FLUX on DreamOmni2.

zh.title: 先用三维场景规划，再让图像生成精准构图
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出 MAGPIE，用于根据多张参考图和文字指令生成图像，同时保留指定主体的外观并安排好它们的位置关系。它先把目标构图表示为可执行的 Blender 程序，生成简化的三维场景，并由编码智能体检查和修改场景，使其更符合指令。随后，图像生成器以场景渲染图作为视觉规划，并从各自的参考图中获取主体外观。研究还构建了 MAGPIE-Instruct-3K 数据集用于训练；实验显示，该方法提升了 Qwen 和 FLUX 在 DreamOmni2 与 SconeEval 上的表现。

papers.title: On-Policy Codec Distillation for Efficient All-in-One Video Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract  Modern visual generative models operate on tokens, and every visual asset they receive, whether an identity, a scribble, a depth map, or a motion video, is tokenized and appended to the input token sequence. Consequently, conditioning quickly dominates the computation cost. Yet most of these tokens carry redundant spatiotemporal information. Our key insight is that identifying what is genuinely new is exactly the problem that classical video codecs have long solved. Thus, we first introduce a codec-based token pruning method that discards redundant tokens. Then, we propose an on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) strategy to train a DiT adapter capable of learning the codec pruning pattern well without quality degradation. Together, they form On-Policy Codec Distillation (CodecOPSD). We scale CodecOPSD to 16 condition modalities on our own video diffusion model, where it prunes 66% of the condition tokens on average with almost no quality drop. Therefore, denoising becomes 2x faster, and the cache memory shrinks by up to 73% in KV cache mode. CodecOPSD also extends to other state-of-the-art pretrained image and video generative models, where its benefit grows further with more conditions, longer frames, and higher resolution.

ru.title: Сжимаем условия как видеокодек: меньше токенов, та же качество генерации
ru.desc: Современные генеративные модели для изображений и видео работают с токенами, и каждое условие (идентичность, эскиз, карта глубины, видео движения) добавляется в последовательность, из-за чего вычисления быстро растут. Авторы предлагают CodecOPSD: метод прунинга токенов на основе классического видеокодека, который отбрасывает избыточную пространственно-временную информацию и оставляет только действительно новое. Затем DiT-адаптер обучается через on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), чтобы воспроизводить этот паттерн прунинга без потери качества. В экспериментах с 16 модальностями условий удаляется в среднем 66% токенов, денойзинг ускоряется примерно в 2 раза, а KV-кэш уменьшается до 73%.

en.title: Prune the Redundancy, Keep the Quality
en.desc: Visual generative models process conditioning information as tokens, but many tokens repeat information across space and time. CodecOPSD uses ideas from video codecs to identify and prune these redundant condition tokens. It trains a DiT adapter with on-policy self-distillation to reproduce this pruning while preserving output quality. Across 16 condition modalities, it removes an average of 66% of tokens, making denoising about twice as fast and reducing KV cache memory by up to 73%.

zh.title: 借鉴视频编码去冗余，让视觉生成更快更省
zh.desc: 现代视觉生成模型会把身份、涂鸦、深度图和视频等条件转换为 token，但许多 token 包含重复的时空信息，增加了计算开销。论文借鉴传统视频编码，提出基于编码器的 token 剪枝方法，去除冗余条件 token。作者还提出在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD），训练 DiT 适配器学习这种剪枝模式，同时尽量保持生成质量；两者结合称为 CodecOPSD。在视频扩散模型中，它平均减少 66% 的条件 token，几乎不损失质量，使去噪速度提升约 2 倍，并在 KV 缓存模式下最多减少 73% 的缓存内存。

papers.title: Don't Sleep, Keep Watch: Proactive Perception for Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract NightWatch adds a lightweight streaming watcher to vision-language computer-use agents to keep perception synchronized with dynamic interfaces, reducing latency and wasted time while maintaining or improving task success.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Computer-use agents (CUAs) built on vision-language models are increasingly entrusted with long-horizon tasks in live desktop, web, and mobile environments, where the screen keeps changing on its own. However, current CUAs lack real-time situational awareness: they perceive the environment through discrete snapshots, and the substantial inference latency of VLMs, compounded by highly dynamic interfaces, opens a perception-action gap in which the observed state frequently becomes stale before the corresponding action is executed. To bridge this gap, we present NightWatch, a plug-and-play framework that endows any CUA with continuous, temporally grounded perception without changing the agent's model, prompt, or action space. NightWatch couples the VLM agent with NightWatch-0.8B, a lightweight System-1 model that performs streaming monitoring of the interface state and keeps the agent synchronized with the evolving environment at low computational cost and latency, thereby grounding each decision in the current state rather than an outdated snapshot and reducing both stale actions and idle waiting while preserving task success. Experiments on desktop and dynamic web environments (OSWorld-Verified and DynaCU-Bench) show that NightWatch, driven by a watcher of only 0.8B parameters, reduces non-reasoning wall-clock time by 33% and wasted time by 53% on OSWorld while keeping task success on par, raises success on DynaCU-Bench from 39.5% to 44.2% with the large VLM agent, and is more efficient than passive-watching baselines such as AOI and PUSV under the same screenshot-only input, as well as a System-1 decision model more than 30times its size. Overall, NightWatch demonstrates that the timing of perception is as critical as its content, marking a step toward agents that maintain continuous awareness of their environment rather than perceiving it turn by turn.
affiliations: A*STAR Centre for Frontier AI Research (A*STAR CFAR)

ru.title: Важно не только что видеть, но и когда: агент, который не отстаёт от экрана
ru.desc: Статья представляет NightWatch — лёгкий плагин для vision-language агентов, которые управляют компьютером (computer-use agents), и который обеспечивает им непрерывное восприятие интерфейса. Основная проблема в том, что VLM работают с дискретными снимками экрана, и из-за высокой latency инференса действие часто выполняется над уже устаревшим состоянием. Модель NightWatch-0.8B, работающая как System-1 компонент, выполняет streaming-мониторинг интерфейса и синхронизирует агента с изменяющейся средой без изменения самой модели, промпта или пространства действий. В экспериментах на OSWorld-Verified и DynaCU-Bench фреймворк сокращает время простоя и стейл-действия, сохраняя или повышая success rate.

en.title: Keep agents in sync with every changing screen
en.desc: NightWatch helps vision-language computer-use agents stay aware of changing screens instead of relying only on occasional screenshots. A small 0.8-billion-parameter System-1 model continuously monitors the interface and updates the agent’s view, without changing its main model, prompt, or actions. Tests show it reduces wasted time and improves efficiency while keeping task success steady or increasing it on dynamic web tasks. The results suggest that timely perception is important for agents working in environments that change while they act.

zh.title: 持续感知，让智能体始终跟上界面变化
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出 NightWatch，一个可插入视觉语言计算机使用智能体的轻量级框架，无需修改智能体的模型、提示词或动作空间。它使用只有 8 亿参数的 System-1 监测模型，持续追踪界面变化，让智能体依据最新状态而非过时的屏幕截图行动。实验显示，NightWatch 在 OSWorld 上将非推理耗时降低 33%、浪费时间降低 53%，同时保持任务成功率；在 DynaCU-Bench 上也提升了任务成功率。结果表明，及时持续的感知能减少过时操作与空等，感知的时机和内容同样重要。

papers.title: LoopDVR: Looped Transformer for Efficient Dense Visual Recognition
papers.abstract: Abstract LoopDVR converts pretrained Transformer-based dense visual recognition models into parameter-efficient looped networks by selectively reusing Transformer blocks with adapters, reducing parameters while preserving accuracy.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash We propose LoopDVR, a framework for converting pretrained Transformer-based dense visual recognition models into parameter-efficient looped networks. Rather than reducing the network width or depth directly, LoopDVR reuses Transformer blocks across layers in both the ViT backbone and Transformer decoder, reducing the number of parameters while retaining the original computational structure. However, naively sharing parameters can disrupt the distinct transformations learned at different depths. To address this challenge, we identify suitable sharing groups based on inter-layer representation dissimilarity and keep the final backbone block independent for multi-scale feature construction. We then initialize each shared backbone block with the pretrained weights of its group's terminal layer to better preserve the learned representations. An independent Loop Adapter at each layer further helps retain depth-specific transformations within shared blocks. Subsequently, we distill visual representations into the looped backbone and integrate it with a looped decoder for task-specific training. Experiments demonstrate that LoopDVR achieves the best accuracy--parameter trade-offs across dense recognition tasks. Compared with the reference models, it reduces parameters by approximately 28% while maintaining competitive accuracy. Notably, LoopDet-S achieves 50.9 box AP with only 7.0M parameters, highlighting its effectiveness in compact models.

ru.title: Меньше параметров, та же точность: переиспользуем Transformer-блоки
ru.desc: В статье представлен LoopDVR — метод превращения предобученных Transformer-моделей для плотного визуального распознавания (ViT и декодер) в параметрически эффективные looped-сети. Вместо уменьшения ширины или глубины сети блоки Transformer переиспользуются между слоями, что сокращает число параметров при сохранении исходной вычислительной структуры. Для сохранения различий между слоями выбираются группы для разделения весов по межслойной непохожести представлений, а в каждый слой добавляется независимый Loop Adapter, а затем проводится дистилляция в looped-бэкбон. Эксперименты показывают снижение числа параметров примерно на 28% при сохранении конкурентной точности, а LoopDet-S достигает 50.9 box AP всего с 7.0M параметрами.

en.title: Reuse Transformer blocks, keep the accuracy
en.desc: LoopDVR turns pretrained Transformer models for dense visual recognition into smaller, parameter-efficient looped networks. It reuses selected Transformer blocks in both the ViT backbone and decoder, choosing blocks to share based on differences between their representations. Independent adapters at each layer help preserve depth-specific transformations, while representation distillation helps the looped backbone retain useful visual features. Experiments show strong accuracy–parameter trade-offs, including a 28% parameter reduction while maintaining competitive accuracy.

zh.title: 循环复用 Transformer，让模型更轻而精度不减
zh.desc: LoopDVR 将预训练的 Transformer 密集视觉识别模型改造成参数更少的循环网络：它在 ViT 主干网络和 Transformer 解码器中重复使用部分模块，而不直接缩小网络宽度或深度。为减少共享参数对不同层特征变换的影响，方法依据层间表示差异选择共享分组，并让最后一个主干模块保持独立。它还用分组末层的预训练权重初始化共享模块，并在每层加入独立的 Loop Adapter，以保留层特有的变换，再通过知识蒸馏和任务训练提升效果。实验显示，该方法在多种密集视觉识别任务中实现了较好的精度与参数量权衡，参数量约减少 28%；例如 LoopDet-S 仅用 7.0M 参数便达到 50.9 的框 AP。

papers.title: Reinforcing Diffusion Models by Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching
papers.abstract: Abstract  Forward diffusion reinforcement learning (RL)---enabling deterministic ODE sampling without trajectory backpropagation---has grown increasingly popular for efficiently aligning diffusion models. However, we reveal that existing methods essentially rely on signed reward-weighted regression (RWR), regressing the trainable policy velocity onto rollouts from a behavior distribution. Unbiased baseline subtraction implicitly assumes that the policy velocity equals the behavior marginal velocity---an idealized assumption violated under classifier-free guidance (CFG) rollouts, offline/off-policy updates, and imperfect online self-consistency. This behavior--policy mismatch breaks baseline invariance and injects baseline-induced gradient drift, destabilizing training. To resolve this issue, we propose Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching (iTDM), taking the infinitesimal limit of Trajectory Distribution Matching toward a time-local reward-guided target via the posterior-score identity to yield a sample-level gradient anchored at the behavior velocity without learning an additional reward-tilted target score. Tracking this velocity with an online auxiliary denoiser guarantees exact baseline invariance at the auxiliary optimum, effectively suppressing baseline drift across both online and offline RL. Extensive experiments across compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment show that iTDM achieves state-of-the-art in-domain and out-of-domain performance across group-wise online/offline RL and pairwise offline RL. Notably, on the challenging GenEval2 benchmark, iTDM converges nearly 3\times faster than competing methods while scaling smoothly to 0.87 without collapse. Furthermore, iTDM scales effectively to the 5.6B FLUX.3 model, achieving better performance across both in-domain and unseen metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/Luo-Yihong/iTDM
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

ru.title: Стабилизируем обучение диффузионных моделей, выравнивая скорость политики с поведением
ru.desc: В статье рассматривается обучение с подкреплением (RL) для диффузионных моделей, где сэмплирование выполняется детерминированным ODE без обратного распространения по траектории. Авторы показывают, что существующие методы фактически опираются на signed reward-weighted regression, и что допущение о совпадении скорости политики со скоростью поведенческого распределения нарушается при CFG, офлайн-обновлениях и неидеальной онлайн-самосогласованности. Это приводит к смещению градиента, вызванному baseline, и к нестабильности обучения. Предложенный метод iTDM, основанный на бесконечно малом пределе Trajectory Distribution Matching, гарантирует точную инвариантность к baseline и показывает состояние-of-the-art результаты на задачах генерации, рендеринга текста и выравнивания предпочтений.

en.title: Anchor diffusion RL to behavior—and stop baseline drift
en.desc: The paper shows that existing forward diffusion reinforcement learning methods can become unstable when the behavior distribution differs from the policy, because baseline subtraction then introduces gradient drift. It proposes Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching (iTDM), which uses a posterior-score identity to create a local, reward-guided training signal anchored to the behavior velocity. An online auxiliary denoiser tracks that velocity, making baseline subtraction invariant at the auxiliary model’s optimum and reducing drift in both online and offline training. Experiments report strong in-domain and out-of-domain results, faster convergence on GenEval2, and effective scaling to a 5.6B-parameter model.

zh.title: 以行为速度为锚点，让扩散强化学习训练更稳更快
zh.desc: 本文指出，现有扩散强化学习方法本质上依赖带符号奖励加权回归，而行为分布与策略速度不匹配时，基线会引入梯度偏移并导致训练不稳定。作者提出瞬时轨迹分布匹配（iTDM），利用后验得分恒等式构造时间局部的奖励引导目标，并以行为速度为锚点计算样本级梯度，无需额外学习奖励倾斜的目标得分。iTDM通过在线辅助去噪器跟踪行为速度，在辅助模型达到最优时确保基线不变性，从而抑制在线与离线强化学习中的基线漂移。实验显示，iTDM在多种生成与偏好对齐任务上表现领先，在GenEval2上收敛速度接近其他方法的三倍，并能扩展至5.6B参数模型。

papers.title: Residual Guidance for Real-Time Interactive Video Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract Residual Guidance is a training-free method that counteracts context inertia in streaming video generation by adding a residual from denoising the previous chunk under the new prompt to early denoising steps, improving prompt switching without training or per-model tuning.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Real-time interactive video generation allows users to change the prompt during generation to steer the evolving video. However, existing streaming models, which generate videos chunk by chunk, often keep following the previous prompt after a switch. We trace this failure to context inertia, where the previous chunk acts as a strong prior that suppresses the new prompt. Furthermore, we find that this inertia persists even when the cache retains only the previous chunk, yet discarding the context breaks visual continuity, which limits approaches that edit the cache. Rather than editing the cache, we propose Residual Guidance (RG), a simple, training-free method that counteracts context inertia with a correction measured outside the cache. Specifically, RG denoises the re-noised previous chunk once under the new prompt without the cache and adds the resulting residual to the early denoising steps of the next chunk, where its content is largely decided and the new prompt is most suppressed. Across settings ranging from a single switch to long multi-switch generation, RG substantially improves prompt switching capability on existing streaming models, including those with dedicated switching mechanisms, while largely retaining visual quality. As it requires no training or per-model tuning and adds only one forward pass per chunk, RG can be easily integrated into existing real-time video generation pipelines.

ru.title: Новый промпт важнее старого контекста: смена сцены без переобучения
ru.desc: Статья описывает метод Residual Guidance (RG) для потоковой генерации видео по частям (chunk-by-chunk), который решает проблему инерции контекста: модель продолжает следовать старому промпту после его смены. RG не редактирует KV-кэш, а один раз денойзит пересэмплированный предыдущий chunk под новым промптом без кэша и добавляет полученный residual к ранним шагам денойзинга следующего chunk. Метод не требует обучения или подбора параметров под конкретную модель и добавляет лишь один forward pass на chunk. Эксперименты показывают заметное улучшение переключения промптов на существующих streaming-моделях при сохранении визуального качества.

en.title: Break Context Inertia for Better Prompt Switching
en.desc: Streaming video models can keep following an old prompt after users switch to a new one, a problem called context inertia. Residual Guidance (RG) reduces this effect without changing the model’s cache or requiring additional training. It denoises the previous video chunk under the new prompt without using the cache, then applies the resulting residual during the early denoising steps of the next chunk. Experiments show that RG improves prompt switching while largely preserving visual quality, with only one extra model pass per chunk.

zh.title: 不改缓存，用残差让视频及时跟上新提示词
zh.desc: 流式视频生成模型逐段生成视频，但用户切换提示词后，模型常因“上下文惯性”而继续遵循旧提示词。研究发现，即使缓存只保留前一段视频，这种惯性仍然存在；直接删除上下文又会破坏画面连贯性。作者提出残差引导（RG）：在不使用缓存的情况下，按新提示词对重新加噪的前一段视频进行一次去噪，并将得到的残差加入下一段视频早期的去噪步骤。该方法无需训练或针对模型调参，只增加每段一次前向计算，能改善提示词切换效果并大体保持视觉质量。

papers.title: PINE: Point, Instance and Normal Estimation in One-Step Diffusion Model
papers.abstract: Abstract  Understanding a scene requires both geometry and semantics: geometry recovers its spatial structure, and semantics separates it into objects. Current models obtain the two from separate networks or separate passes. We present PINE, a one-step Omni Diffusion Transformer that predicts the point map, the surface normals, and the instance map of an image in one forward pass. PINE treats each map as a token stream, and a stream mask decides which streams interact. A camera-aware ray encoding positions every token by its camera ray rather than its pixel. Grounding attention adds the affinity of pretrained DINOv3 features to the attention logits. Trained on only 139K synthetic images for geometry, PINE achieves state-of-the-art point maps whether or not intrinsics are given and the best average rank on surface normals. It also exceeds SAM on large objects with less than 1 percent of its training images, and it predicts all three maps 5.7x faster than MoGe-3 with SAM.

ru.title: Геометрия и семантика сцены за один проход
ru.desc: Статья представляет PINE — Omni Diffusion Transformer, который за один проход (one-step forward pass) предсказывает карту точек (point map), нормали поверхностей и карту инстансов объектов по одному изображению. Каждая карта обрабатывается как отдельный поток токенов, а маска потоков определяет, какие потоки взаимодействуют между собой. Камерно-зависимое кодирование лучей (camera-aware ray encoding) привязывает токены к лучам камеры, а grounding attention добавляет к логитам внимания сходство признаков предобученного DINOv3. Модель, обученная всего на 139K синтетических изображениях, достигает лучших результатов по картам точек и нормалям и работает в 5.7 раза быстрее MoGe-3 с SAM.

en.title: One pass, three maps: geometry and objects together
en.desc: PINE is a single-pass Omni Diffusion Transformer that predicts an image’s point map, surface normals, and instance map together. It represents each output as a token stream and uses a stream mask to control interactions between them. Camera-ray encodings provide camera-aware positions, while grounding attention uses similarities between pretrained DINOv3 features to guide attention. Trained on 139K synthetic geometry images, PINE achieves strong geometry and segmentation results while producing all three maps 5.7 times faster than MoGe-3 with SAM.

zh.title: 一次前向传播，统一理解场景几何与语义
zh.desc: PINE 是一种全景扩散 Transformer，可在一次前向传播中同时预测图像的点图、表面法线图和实例图。它把每种图表示为一个 token 流，用流掩码控制不同任务之间的信息交互，并用相机感知射线编码表示 token 的位置。模型还将预训练 DINOv3 特征之间的亲和度加入注意力分数，以增强特征对齐。仅用 13.9 万张合成图像训练，PINE 在点图和表面法线预测上表现出色，在大型物体实例分割上也超过 SAM，并且推理速度更快。

papers.title: LoopedWAM: Looped World Action Models for Elastic Inference
papers.abstract: Abstract  World action models (WAMs) couple generative video modeling with robotic action prediction but typically require large video and action transformers, limiting deployment efficiency. We present LoopedWAM, a compact WAM that recurrently applies a shared six-block core in each expert, executing 30 transformer layers while storing only 12 blocks per expert. To account for their asymmetric inference costs, the video and action experts can operate at different depths: visual features are computed once per query, whereas action computation repeats at every sampling step. We further propose elastic self-distillation, which trains a single elastic checkpoint, LoopedWAM-E, across action-depth and sampling-step budgets. With only 0.58B policy parameters and no robot pretraining, LoopedWAM achieves 96.1% success on LIBERO, 91.9% on RoboTwin 2.0, and 52.2% on RoboCasaGR1, while using 7.4times less peak GPU memory than Fast-WAM under matched inference measurements. On LIBERO, LoopedWAM-E achieves 96.0% success in 27.6 ms or 95.2% in 24.7 ms on an H100, providing multiple accuracy-latency operating points from a single checkpoint; with two sampling steps and four action loops, it stays within 0.5 points of LoopedWAM on all three benchmarks. Ablations demonstrate that weight-shared depth preserves competitive performance, while aggressive action-depth reduction requires explicit budget-aware training. On a real AgileX PiPER arm, LoopedWAM succeeds in 71.3% of 80 trials across four tasks.

ru.title: Компактный робот-мозг: один чекпоинт, много режимов скорости и точности
ru.desc: В статье предлагается LoopedWAM — компактная модель мира для роботов (world action model), которая объединяет генеративное видеомоделирование и предсказание действий. Архитектура рекуррентно применяет общий блок трансформера, что даёт 30 слоёв при хранении лишь 12 блоков на эксперт и 0.58B параметров без предобучения на роботах. Видео- и action-эксперты работают на разной глубине: визуальные признаки вычисляются один раз, а вычисления действий повторяются на каждом шаге сэмплирования, что экономит ресурсы. Метод elastic self-distillation позволяет обучить один чекпоинт, который управляет компромиссом между точностью и задержкой, достигая 96.1% на LIBERO и 7.4× меньшего пикового потребления GPU памяти по сравнению с Fast-WAM.

en.title: One compact model, flexible speed and accuracy
en.desc: LoopedWAM is a compact world action model that generates video predictions and robot actions using a small transformer core repeatedly, reducing the number of stored model blocks. It computes visual features once per query and lets action processing use a different depth, since action computation repeats at every sampling step. Its elastic self-distillation trains one model to work across different action-depth and sampling-step budgets, offering several speed and accuracy options. The model achieves strong results on simulated benchmarks and real robot trials while using substantially less peak GPU memory than a comparison model.

zh.title: 共享循环计算，让机器人动作模型更轻、更灵活
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出 LoopedWAM，一种紧凑的世界动作模型，通过循环复用共享的 Transformer 模块，减少模型存储和显存需求。它让视频专家和动作专家使用不同计算深度，以适应视觉特征只需计算一次、动作预测却要在每个采样步骤重复计算的特点。论文还提出弹性自蒸馏，在同一个模型检查点中训练不同的动作计算深度和采样步数，从而提供多种速度与精度配置。在多个机器人操作基准和真实机械臂测试中，LoopedWAM取得了有竞争力的成功率，并显著降低显存占用。

papers.title: AdProducer: Towards Agentic Advertising Video Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract An end-to-end multimodal agent framework autonomously researches products and creates selling-point-driven storyboards to guide a frozen video generator, trained via supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to produce effective advertising videos.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Recent advances in video generation have made automated advertising production increasingly feasible. However, an effective advertisement must faithfully represent the product and communicate its selling points through compelling visual storytelling, which requires more than visual synthesis: it calls for deeper product understanding and strategic decisions about how to present product value. Crucially, product research and creative design are closely intertwined, as the information gathered about a product determines which features can be faithfully demonstrated and how they should be presented. In this paper, we introduce AdProducer, the first end-to-end agentic framework for advertising video creation, transforming concise creative briefs into finished advertisements. Our multimodal agent autonomously researches products through web and image search and translates its findings into selling-point-driven storyboards that guide a frozen video generator. To achieve this, we develop a dedicated data construction pipeline that yields two training datasets, AdProducer-SFT and AdProducer-RL, and train the agent through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with joint optimization of storyboard- and video-level rewards. We further introduce AdCreation-Bench, comprising 305 advertising briefs across eight domains, with two complementary metrics: PG-Score for product correctness and creative execution, and Ad-Score for overall advertising effectiveness assessed by an independent judge. Experiments demonstrate that AdProducer improves the PG-Score of MiniMax H3 from 17.3 to 51.3 and generalizes to Veo 3.1 without additional training, improving its score from 28.0 to 35.9, with consistent gains in Ad-Score, VideoScore2, and human evaluations. Code, models, and data are released.
affiliations: Institute of Artificial Intelligence, University of Central Florida

ru.title: Агент, который сначала изучит продукт, а потом снимет рекламу
ru.desc: В статье представлен AdProducer — end-to-end агентная система на базе мультимодального LLM-агента, которая создаёт рекламные видео из краткого брифа. Агент самостоятельно исследует продукт через веб- и поиск по изображениям и на основе найденных сведений формирует storyboard, ориентированный на ключевые преимущества продукта, который управляет замороженным видеогенератором. Агент обучается в два этапа: supervised fine-tuning и reinforcement learning с совместной оптимизацией наград на уровне storyboard и итогового видео. Для оценки авторы вводят бенчмарк AdCreation-Bench и метрики PG-Score и Ad-Score, а эксперименты показывают заметный рост качества, в том числе при переносе на Veo 3.1 без дополнительного обучения.

en.title: Research the Product, Then Tell Its Story
en.desc: AdProducer turns short advertising briefs into finished videos using a multimodal agent. The agent searches the web and images to learn about each product, then creates a storyboard that highlights its selling points and guides a frozen video generator. It is trained with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, using rewards for both storyboard quality and video quality. On a new benchmark, it improves product accuracy and advertising effectiveness, and its benefits transfer to another video generator without extra training.

zh.title: 先懂产品，再创作打动人的广告视频
zh.desc: 本文提出 AdProducer，一个端到端的多模态智能体框架，可把简短的广告需求转化为完整广告视频。智能体会通过网页和图片搜索了解产品，再制作突出产品卖点的分镜脚本，引导一个冻结的视频生成模型生成视频。研究者先用监督微调训练智能体，再用强化学习优化分镜和视频层面的奖励，并构建了广告评测基准。实验表明，该方法能提升广告的产品准确性与整体效果，也能迁移到未参与训练的视频生成模型。

papers.title: Coding4Games: Can Modern Coding Agents Play Modern Video Games?
papers.abstract: Abstract  Games, especially modern AAA games, challenge language models to perceive complex scenes, control actions, and make decisions over long horizons. Existing game benchmarks primarily test language models as computer-use agents that query a language model throughout play, incurring repeated inference cost and, in real-time games, acting while the environment continues to evolve. We ask whether coding agents can learn from game interaction to develop standalone game-playing programs that run without language model inference. We thus introduce Coding4Games, a benchmark for evaluating whether coding agents can develop standalone programs that play modern games through visual observations and standard game inputs. Coding4Games has three defining features: 1) Diverse Modern Games, covering 15 games with diverse visual, strategic, and control demands; 2) Development-Test Separation, in which a coding agent uses a sandbox and the standard player interface to iteratively develop a program, after which the selected program is frozen and independently tested without language-model inference; and 3) Outcome and Process Evaluation, which measures not only game performance and reliability but also how agents use feedback, revise programs, and resolve problems during development. Across 15 games, the best program per game outscores the strongest GUI baseline on 13 and ties it on one. The human player outscores all agents on 10 games. We additionally examine the effects of development budgets. Coding4Games evaluates whether coding agents can turn their understanding of complex interactive environments into programs that work reliably on their own.

ru.title: Программы, которые играют сами, без LLM
ru.desc: В статье представлен бенчмарк Coding4Games для оценки того, могут ли coding agents создавать автономные программы, играющие в современные игры по визуальным наблюдениям и стандартным игровым инпутам. Разработка программы ведётся в песочнице, после чего выбранная программа «замораживается» и тестируется без каких-либо вызовов LLM. Бенчмарк охватывает 15 игр и оценивает не только игровой результат и надёжность, но и то, как агент использует обратную связь и исправляет ошибки в процессе разработки. Результаты показывают, что лучшие программы превосходят сильнейший GUI-baseline в 13 играх из 15, но люди по-прежнему играют лучше агентов в 10 играх.

en.title: Build It, Freeze It, Play: Testing Standalone Game Agents
en.desc: This paper introduces Coding4Games, a benchmark for testing whether coding agents can build programs that play modern games from visual observations and standard inputs. Agents develop and refine their programs in a sandbox, then the programs are frozen and tested without further language-model inference. The benchmark evaluates game results and reliability, as well as how agents use feedback and fix problems during development. The best program beats a strong GUI-based agent in 13 of 15 games, while human players outperform all agents in 10 games.

zh.title: 从游戏互动中学习，让程序独立闯关
zh.desc: 本文提出 Coding4Games 基准，用于评估编程智能体能否通过与游戏互动，编写无需语言模型持续推理的独立游戏程序。基准包含 15 款现代游戏，并将程序开发阶段与独立测试阶段分开，以检验程序在视觉观察和标准游戏输入下的实际表现。评估不仅考察游戏成绩与可靠性，也考察智能体如何利用反馈、修改程序和解决开发问题。实验显示，各游戏中表现最佳的程序在 13 款游戏中胜过最强的图形界面智能体基线、在 1 款中持平，但人类玩家在 10 款游戏中胜过所有智能体。

papers.title: Can an Agent Trust Its Own Zoom? Cross-Magnification Provenance Verification for Whole-Slide Images
papers.abstract: Abstract  Visual agents navigate whole-slide images through magnified observations associated with claimed locations. However, a visually plausible observation does not necessarily originate from its claimed location, particularly across magnifications and in regions with similar tissue structures. We formulate cross-magnification provenance verification (CMPV) to evaluate whether visual evidence supports a claimed spatial association, recover the source when possible, and abstain when evidence is insufficient. We introduce PyraFault, a benchmark of 3.06 million coordinate-supervised examples from 2,200 cases across five TCGA cohorts, covering within-context substitutions, absent-source faults, and geometric perturbations. We further propose ZoomTrace, a claim-independent verifier that estimates the observation's source before evaluating its agreement with the claimed location. It combines physical-scale alignment, visual retrieval, geometric refinement, and reliability estimation using spatially disjoint competing matches. On 503,320 test examples, ZoomTrace achieves 0.969 AUPRC and 0.987 AUROC, compared with 0.789 and 0.903 for Efficient LoFTR. Further evaluations reveal trade-offs in reliability estimation and limitations in vision-language models, cross-dataset retrieval, and calibration. Integrating ZoomTrace into visual agent tool paths reduces exposure to corrupted observations and silent failures, while downstream accuracy improvements depend on the agent and verification threshold.

ru.title: Проверяй, откуда кадр: надёжная верификация увеличения в гистологии
ru.desc: Авторы рассматривают задачу проверки происхождения изображения при переходе между разными уровнями увеличения в гигапиксельных снимках гистологических препаратов (WSI). Для этого предложен бенчмарк PyraFault с более чем 3 млн примеров с координатной разметкой, включающий подмены внутри контекста, отсутствующие источники и геометрические искажения. Метод ZoomTrace сначала оценивает истинный источник наблюдения, используя выравнивание масштаба, визуальный поиск и геометрическое уточнение, и только затем сравнивает его с заявленным местом, а надёжность оценивается на основе пространственно непересекающихся конкурирующих совпадений. На тестовой выборке ZoomTrace показывает AUPRC 0.969 и AUROC 0.987, заметно превосходя Efficient LoFTR, а также выявляет ограничения vision-language моделей и калибровки.

en.title: Verify the source before trusting the view
en.desc: The paper studies whether a magnified view of a whole-slide image truly comes from the location it claims to show. It introduces PyraFault, a benchmark with millions of coordinate-labeled examples, including incorrect substitutions, missing sources, and geometric distortions. The proposed ZoomTrace first estimates where an image came from, then checks whether that source matches the claimed location, combining scale alignment, visual retrieval, geometric refinement, and reliability estimation. ZoomTrace outperforms the comparison method on the benchmark, and its use can help agents avoid corrupted observations, though benefits depend on the agent and verification threshold.

zh.title: 先追溯图像来源，再核验位置主张
zh.desc: 这篇论文研究跨倍率来源验证（CMPV），判断全切片图像中的观察是否确实来自所声称的位置，并在证据不足时拒绝判断。作者构建了 PyraFault 基准数据集，包含来自五个 TCGA 队列、2200 个病例的 306 万个带坐标标注样本。作者提出 ZoomTrace：先估计观察的真实来源，再核验它是否与声称位置一致；方法结合物理尺度对齐、视觉检索、几何细化和可靠性估计。在测试集上，ZoomTrace 的 AUPRC 和 AUROC 均高于 Efficient LoFTR，但其可靠性评估、跨数据集检索和校准仍有局限，且能否提升下游准确率取决于智能体和验证阈值。

papers.title: VenusOCR2.0: Towards Efficient and Effective Document Parsing
papers.abstract: Abstract  We present VenusOCR2.0, a compact 1B-parameter vision-language recognizer designed for both high-accuracy and high-throughput document parsing across text, tables, and formulas. To continuously improve recognition quality without self-training collapse, we build a bounded recursive self-improvement (RSI) data engine where the model acts strictly as a weakness probe, while external multi-expert medoid consensus, VLM visual verification, and factorized synthesis supply reliable supervision across pretraining, curated SFT, and RLVR. VenusOCR2.0 couples a dynamic-resolution SigLIP2 encoder and 2x2 spatial token merging with a Qwen3-0.6B decoder, adopting compact atomic OTSL tokens to shorten table sequences and reduce structural errors. To further eliminate the autoregressive decoding bottleneck, we introduce PTPv2, a lightweight (sim67M) decoupled parallel draft module that combines frozen multi-layer verifier conditioning, a standalone learned mask, and block-causal all-position next-token prediction. On OmniDocBenchv1.6, VenusOCR2.0 achieves an overall score of 96.45 and a state-of-the-art 98.57 formula CDM, substantially outperforming massive general-purpose VLMs such as Gemini-3-Pro (92.91) and Qwen3-VL-235B (89.78). Deployed in vLLM on a single H20 GPU, PTPv2 delivers a 2.96x single-request speedup and up to 2.36x higher batched throughput while guaranteeing lossless, token-for-token equivalence with standard autoregressive decoding.

ru.title: Компактный OCR-эксперт, который читает документы быстрее и точнее гигантов
ru.desc: Статья представляет VenusOCR2.0 — компактную vision-language модель с 1 млрд параметров для распознавания документов, включая текст, таблицы и формулы. Для улучшения качества используется ограниченный рекурсивный self-improvement (RSI) пайплайн, где модель лишь выявляет слабые места, а разметку обеспечивают мультиэкспертный консенсус, VLM-верификация и синтез данных на этапах pretraining, SFT и RLVR. Архитектура объединяет SigLIP2-энкодер, Qwen3-0.6B декодер и компактные токены OTSL для таблиц, а модуль PTPv2 ускоряет декодирование параллельным драфтингом без потери качества. Модель превосходит крупные general-purpose VLM на OmniDocBench и даёт ускорение инференса до 2.96x на одном GPU.

en.title: Accurate document reading, with faster decoding
en.desc: VenusOCR2.0 is a compact vision-language model that reads documents, including text, tables, and formulas. It improves its training data using expert agreement and visual checks, while using its own predictions only to identify weak spots. A parallel drafting module speeds up text generation while preserving exactly the same output as standard autoregressive decoding. The system achieves strong document-recognition results and runs efficiently on a single GPU.

zh.title: 小模型精准识文档，并行解码提速不丢精度
zh.desc: 论文提出 VenusOCR2.0，这是一个仅有 10 亿参数的视觉语言模型，可高精度、高效率地识别文档中的文字、表格和公式。研究团队采用有界递归自我改进数据流程，并结合多专家共识、视觉核验与合成数据来提供可靠训练监督，避免模型自我训练导致性能退化。模型通过动态分辨率视觉编码器和紧凑的表格标记提升识别效果，并加入并行草稿模块，加快文本生成且保持与标准自回归解码完全一致。它在 OmniDocBench v1.6 上取得 96.45 的综合分数和 98.57 的公式识别分数；在单张 H20 GPU 上，解码速度最高提升 2.96 倍。

papers.title: Qwen-Image-HD: Autoregressive Diffusion for High Definition Image Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract  Fine-tuning a generator on a complete high-resolution canvas requires long image sequences and substantial computation, yet local regions can still exhibit unnatural repetitive stripes when training resources are limited. We introduce Qwen-Image-HD, which adapts Qwen-Image 2.0 to high-resolution synthesis through local training and blockwise autoregressive generation. Each prediction covers a target tile at 1K scale, conditioned on high-resolution upper and left neighbors and a compressed historical thumbnail. These conditions provide adjacent fine-scale structures and an overview of the scene generated so far. To integrate these complementary cues, we map both forms of history and the target to a shared canvas coordinate system to express their spatial relationships and scale differences. On Qwen-Image-Bench at 4K, Qwen-Image-HD achieves stronger overall evaluation performance than direct 4K generation with FLUX-3-Image-Klein. Compared with full-image 4K supervised fine-tuning of the same backbone, it achieves better generation quality with lower training compute and higher inference efficiency, while exhibiting fewer unnatural repetitive stripes in original-resolution comparisons. We further introduce a Wavefront-AutoRegressive inference schedule that generates tiles on the same anti-diagonal concurrently across GPUs to reduce single-image latency.

ru.title: Высокое разрешение по кусочкам: быстрее, чище и без полос
ru.desc: Авторы представляют Qwen-Image-HD, метод адаптации генеративной модели Qwen-Image 2.0 для синтеза изображений в высоком разрешении. Изображение создаётся блоками (тайлами) размером 1K в режиме блочной авторегрессии, что позволяет обучать модель локально и избегать длинных последовательностей. Каждый тайл условно генерируется на основе соседних фрагментов высокого разрешения и сжатой миниатюры уже созданной части сцены, а все эти данные сводятся к общей системе координат холста. На бенчмарке Qwen-Image-Bench при 4K метод превосходит прямую генерацию и полное SFT-дообучение по качеству, вычислительным затратам и эффективности инференса, а также предлагает схему Wavefront-AutoRegressive для параллельной генерации тайлов на нескольких GPU.

en.title: Build high-resolution images tile by tile, with the whole scene in view.
en.desc: Qwen-Image-HD adapts Qwen-Image 2.0 for high-resolution image generation using local training and blockwise autoregressive generation. It predicts each 1K tile from high-resolution tiles above and to the left, along with a compressed thumbnail summarizing the image so far. Mapping these inputs and the target into a shared canvas coordinate system helps the model combine fine-scale details with the overall scene layout. On 4K benchmarks, it delivers stronger image quality with less training compute and fewer repetitive stripes, while a wavefront schedule generates independent tiles concurrently to reduce latency.

zh.title: 分块生成高分辨率图像：更清晰、更高效、更少条纹
zh.desc: 本文提出 Qwen-Image-HD，通过局部训练和分块自回归生成，让模型以较低计算成本合成高分辨率图像。模型每次预测一个 1K 尺寸的图块，并参考高分辨率的上方与左侧邻块，以及压缩后的历史缩略图。它将这些信息和目标图块映射到统一画布坐标系，以便融合邻近细节与整体场景布局。实验显示，该方法在 4K 图像生成质量、训练计算量和推理效率方面表现更好，并减少了不自然的重复条纹；波前自回归调度还可并行生成图块，降低单张图像的延迟。

papers.title: Align the Pair, Not the Sample: Representation Alignment for Faster and Better One-Step Generato
papers.abstract: Abstract In one-step generator training, aligning the paired reconstruction path rather than the generative path improves recall and sample quality while accelerating both training stages and lowering FID.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Representation alignment markedly accelerates diffusion training, but one-step generators raise a question that diffusion does not: which training path should receive the loss? A one-step generator sees two kinds of inputs. Corrupted real images come with their clean counterpart, which provides an instance-paired target. Samples generated from pure noise have no corresponding real image, yet this is where the final model operates. We study this question on Priming, which trains one-step generators from scratch by reconstructing corrupted images and then matching feature distributions with optimal transport.
