Aligning the generative path, the natural choice, collapses recall (0.45!to!0.15--0.25) in all 17 configurations we test, including five target constructions and loss weights down to 0.05. Aligning the paired reconstruction path with a frozen DINOv2 encoder instead helps in every setting we test. A short analysis explains this asymmetry: when the target carries no instance information about the input, the optimal aligned feature is constant within each class, so the loss pulls samples toward class prototypes. A control confirms this: aligning the paired path to a random same-class image instead of the input's own image removes most of the gain. Inside the generator, paired-path alignment creates an interface block through which post-training routes noise, and the image semantics carried through it predict sample quality across 16 models. The resulting recipe, \method, accelerates both training stages on ImageNet 256!times!256: it matches the 160-epoch baseline with 2times fewer priming epochs, surpasses its final quality with 4times fewer post-training updates, and lowers FID to 1.30 (B) and 1.155 (L) at the standard budget. A joint single-stage variant trains native one-step generators and reaches FID 1.22 with 115M parameters.

ru.title: Выравнивайте парный путь реконструкции, а не генеративный, и обучение одношагового генератора станет быстрее и качественнее
ru.desc: В статье исследуется, какой путь обучения одношагового генератора стоит выравнивать с признаками внешнего энкодера. Авторы показывают, что выравнивание генеративного пути, то есть сгенерированных из шума образцов, резко снижает recall, тогда как выравнивание парного пути реконструкции с замороженным DINOv2 стабильно помогает. Причина в том, что без информации об экземпляре оптимальный признак становится константным внутри класса, и лосс стягивает образцы к прототипам классов. Предложенный рецепт ускоряет обе стадии обучения на ImageNet 256x256 и снижает FID до 1.30 и 1.155, а совместный одностадийный вариант достигает FID 1.22.

en.title: Align the Paired Path for Faster, Better One-Step Generation
en.desc: The paper studies where to apply representation-alignment loss when training one-step image generators. Aligning generated samples to feature targets without instance-specific information can pull them toward class prototypes, reducing recall and sample quality. Instead, aligning corrupted images with their own clean counterparts using a frozen DINOv2 encoder improves results across the tested settings. This approach speeds up both training stages and achieves lower FID, including 1.22 for a joint single-stage model.

zh.title: 对齐配对重建路径，让一步生成更快、更好
zh.desc: 这篇论文研究一步生成器应该在哪条训练路径上进行特征对齐：从噪声生成的路径，还是带有真实图像配对目标的重建路径。实验发现，用冻结的 DINOv2 编码器对齐配对重建路径，能提升样本质量与召回率；对齐生成路径则会导致召回率明显下降。原因是生成路径的目标缺少输入图像对应的实例信息，特征对齐可能把样本推向类别原型；而配对路径保留了图像的语义信息。基于这一发现，论文提出的方法减少了训练所需的轮数和更新次数，并在 ImageNet 上取得更低的 FID。

papers.title: Clinical3D-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Spatial Intelligence of Multimodal LLMs in Hospital Environments
papers.abstract: Abstract A simulated hospital benchmark shows that multimodal large language models have limited spatial reasoning, while fine-tuning and a 3D-computation method improve their accuracy and reduce the gap to physicians.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Spatial reasoning in hospitals requires tracking look-alike equipment, interpreting patient-relative directions, and judging passage widths, yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of these abilities. We introduce Clinical3D-Bench, a simulated benchmark with 3,368 questions of eight types on egocentric walkthroughs of 373 hospital-room layouts. Layouts follow hospital design guidelines, answers are computed from the 3D scenes, and paired scene states test whether models change their answers when relevant evidence changes. Videos are photorealistic, and ten physicians screened the layouts. Among 35 multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the best open and proprietary models reach 45.7% and 53.6% macro accuracy, against 40.8% for an answer prior and 79.0% for physicians on a subset, and 27 of 32 open models score below 40% on two-way patient-relative directions. Fine-tuning on Clinical3D-45K, our 44,750-question training set, lifts two MLLMs 16-20 points above the best proprietary model. 3D maps given to the fine-tuned MLLM as input go largely unused: replacing them with another video's, even when they are ground truth, barely changes its accuracy. The proposed GeoJeV instead lets the MLLM compute with 3D: it reconstructs a scene memory from each video, selects 3D operations and their arguments from the MLLM's question state, and adds their evidence to its option scores. It achieves the highest accuracy of all evaluated models, narrowing the gap to physicians.
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China

ru.title: Чтобы понимать пространство больницы, LLM должна вычислять в 3D, а не только смотреть видео
ru.desc: Авторы представляют Clinical3D-Bench — симулированный бенчмарк из 3368 вопросов по видеопрогулкам по 373 планировкам больничных палат, проверяющий пространственное мышление мультимодальных LLM. Лучшие модели показывают лишь около 45–54% точности против 79% у врачей, а большинство открытых моделей плохо справляются с направлениями относительно пациента. Дообучение на Clinical3D-45K заметно повышает качество, но 3D-карты почти не используются моделью. Предложенный метод GeoJeV строит 3D-память сцены, выполняет геометрические операции и добавляет их результаты к оценкам вариантов ответа, достигая лучшей точности среди всех моделей.

en.title: Give Language Models 3D Tools to Navigate Hospital Scenes
en.desc: The paper introduces Clinical3D-Bench, a benchmark for testing whether multimodal large language models can reason about hospital spaces from videos. It finds that current models struggle with tasks such as tracking similar equipment, interpreting directions relative to a patient, and estimating passage widths. Fine-tuning improves accuracy, but models make little use of provided 3D maps. The proposed GeoJeV method uses the model to select operations over a reconstructed 3D scene, improving accuracy and reducing the gap with physicians.

zh.title: 让多模态模型真正用三维计算理解医院空间
zh.desc: 本文提出 Clinical3D-Bench，用于评测多模态大语言模型在医院场景中的空间推理能力，涵盖辨认相似设备、理解相对患者的方向和判断通道宽度等任务。基准包含 3,368 道问题，并通过改变场景中的相关证据来测试模型能否相应调整答案。实验显示，现有模型整体表现有限，尤其难以判断以患者为参照的方向；使用该基准数据微调后，两个模型的准确率显著提升。作者提出 GeoJeV，让模型从视频重建三维场景记忆，并调用三维计算操作辅助选答案，使其在评测中准确率最高，并缩小与医生的差距。

papers.title: Embodied AI Fails the Mirror Test: How a Simple Mirror Breaks Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Abstract A new benchmark shows that many robot manipulation policies perform worse when mirrors are present, often because they confuse reflections with real objects rather than simply colliding with the mirror.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Can a simple mirror expose the limitations of today's robotic manipulation policies? Inspired by the mirror self-recognition test in animal cognition, we investigate whether robot policies can reliably manipulate physical objects in scenes containing their reflections. We introduce RoboDojo-Mirror, a benchmark built on RoboDojo that preserves task objectives, success criteria, and policy checkpoints while comparing a mirror-free baseline with single-mirror, dual-mirror, and mirrored-tabletop conditions. Across five policies spanning Vision-Language-Action models, World Action Models, and agentic policies, every mirror condition reduces aggregate success rates: averaged over the three conditions, the drop ranges from 10.8 to 56.7 percentage points across policies, and it reaches 62.5 points on the mirrored tabletop. Because a mirror is also a physical obstacle, we compare it against geometrically matched non-reflective panels; 50--88\% of mirror-specific failures occur without recorded robot--panel contact, so direct collisions alone do not explain the degradation. Trajectory and contact analyses instead reveal recurring behaviors consistent with phantom targeting of reflected objects and spatial mislocalization of real ones. Targeted diagnostics further characterize grasping near reflections, policy-dependent pushing progress, and physical-target interaction under main-camera occlusion. Real-robot experiments with π_{0.5} and FastWAM also show lower overall success rates under the upright-mirror and mirrored-tabletop conditions. These findings reveal a shared vulnerability to reflective environments across diverse robot policies and motivate reflection-aware evaluation of embodied intelligence. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/robodojo-mirror.

ru.title: Зеркало ломает роботов: отражение сбивает с толку даже лучшие policy-модели
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают бенчмарк RoboDojo-Mirror, который проверяет, могут ли робототехнические policy-модели (VLA, World Action Models и агентные политики) надёжно манипулировать объектами при наличии зеркал в сцене. Во всех зеркальных условиях успешность снижается, иногда на десятки процентных пунктов, причём большинство ошибок происходит без контакта робота с зеркалом, то есть дело не только в физическом препятствии. Анализ траекторий показывает, что модели пытаются хватать отражения (phantom targeting) и неверно определяют положение реальных объектов. Это указывает на общую уязвимость embodied AI к отражающим поверхностям и мотивирует оценку с учётом отражений.

en.title: Mirrors Reveal a Blind Spot in Robot Manipulation
en.desc: The paper introduces RoboDojo-Mirror, a benchmark for testing robot manipulation policies in scenes with mirrors. Across five kinds of policies, mirrors reduce task success, with especially large drops when the tabletop is reflective. Comparisons with non-reflective panels suggest that collisions alone do not explain the failures; robots often appear to target reflected objects or misjudge where real objects are. Real-robot tests show similar weaknesses, highlighting the need to evaluate policies in reflective environments.

zh.title: 镜中虚像，照出机器人操作策略的盲点
zh.desc: 本文提出 RoboDojo-Mirror 基准，用来评估机器人操作策略在镜面环境中的表现，并与无镜面场景进行比较。实验覆盖视觉-语言-动作模型、世界动作模型和智能体策略，发现所有策略在镜面条件下的成功率都有下降，镜面桌面造成的影响尤其明显。与非反光障碍物的对照实验显示，许多镜面相关失败并非由机器人撞上镜子导致，而是与追踪镜中虚像或误判真实物体位置有关。真实机器人实验也观察到类似问题，说明不同类型的操作策略普遍缺乏对反射环境的适应能力。

papers.title: Factorized Context Attention: From Emulated to Native Grid Probing
papers.abstract: Abstract Factorized Context Attention is a training-free block-sparse attention method that natively reproduces grid probing’s span-based attention pattern, encoding input once into a KV cache to match accuracy and extend context at lower cost across video, text, and image tasks.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Models read a book, an hour of video, or an image in one forward pass. As the context grows, this pass slows down, loses accuracy, and stops at the context window. Sparse attention is efficient, but keeps the other two limitations. Grid probing, a recent training-free method, recovers the accuracy and extends the reach by asking a frozen model the same question about short local and strided spans of the input, but every question repeats the whole computation, since each span is encoded again. Our insight is that grid probing is emulated attention, an attention pattern reproduced from outside the model through prompts, since each probe only restricts which part of the input the question can see. We introduce Factorized Context Attention (FCA), a training-free block-sparse attention that runs the same pattern natively, as the attention of the model itself. FCA encodes the input once into a KV cache, reads all spans as masked sequences in one batched forward, and uses a stair position schedule to keep every span inside the trained position range. Across long video understanding, long-context text inference and image grounding, FCA matches the accuracy and the reach of grid probing at a fraction of its cost. It gains about 10 points over the single pass on long video and 9 to 14 points on long novels, finds needles in videos of over a thousand frames and in texts four times the length of the window, and answers a later question about the same input in as little as a tenth of the time of grid probing. Native attention thus keeps what emulated attention gains without its cost, all with existing frozen language and vision-language models.
affiliations: Department of Computer Science, Edge Hill University, Ormskirk, England
King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), Thuwal, Saudi Arabia

ru.title: Нативное внимание вместо имитации: точность grid probing без его цены
ru.desc: Статья представляет Factorized Context Attention (FCA) — метод блочно-разреженного внимания без обучения, который встраивает паттерн grid probing непосредственно в механизм attention модели. Вход кодируется один раз в KV cache, а все локальные и страйд-спаны обрабатываются как замаскированные последовательности в одном батчевом forward-проходе с использованием stair position schedule. Такой подход сохраняет точность и дальность охвата контекста, сравнимые с grid probing, но работает существенно быстрее, в том числе при повторных вопросах к тому же входу. Метод применим к существующим замороженным LLM и VLM и показывает улучшения на длинных видео, длинных текстах и задачах grounding по изображениям.

en.title: Grid probing’s reach, with one encoding and native attention
en.desc: Factorized Context Attention (FCA) is a training-free, block-sparse attention method that reproduces grid probing directly inside a model. It encodes the input once into a key-value (KV) cache, then uses masked attention over local and strided spans in a batched forward pass. A stair position schedule keeps those spans within the model’s trained position range, helping FCA handle contexts beyond the usual window. Across video, text, and image tasks, it matches grid probing’s accuracy and reach at much lower computational cost.

zh.title: 让稀疏注意力原生实现网格探测，兼顾长上下文与低成本
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出因子化上下文注意力（FCA），一种无需训练的块稀疏注意力方法。它把网格探测所用的局部与跨步跨度注意力模式直接实现为模型内部的注意力计算，并将输入编码一次存入键值（KV）缓存，再通过掩码序列批量读取各个跨度。阶梯式位置安排让每个跨度都处于模型训练过的位置范围内，有助于在扩展上下文时保持准确性。实验显示，FCA在长视频、长文本和图像任务上达到接近网格探测的效果，同时显著降低计算成本。

papers.title: ThinkMorph-SSL: Scaling Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning with Pretext Tasks
papers.abstract: Abstract A two-stage training approach uses visual pretext tasks to generate interleaved image-text reasoning traces and automatically built demonstrations, improving multimodal reasoning over instruction tuning alone.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash People reason with pictures as well as words. Interleaved multimodal reasoning gives models a similar way to solve problems by creating intermediate images and using them to guide further reasoning. Training models with this ability usually relies on task-specific demonstrations, which are difficult to collect. We introduce ThinkMorph-SSL, a two-stage training recipe that uses images themselves as a source of supervision. The first stage, pretext reasoning, converts visual pretext tasks, such as image colorization and denoising, into instruction-free interleaved traces. Models describe a corrupted or transformed image, generate a restored or canonical image, and interpret the result. The second stage uses automatically constructed demonstrations for question-driven instruction tuning. At the same instruction-tuning budget, models trained with pretext reasoning outperform those trained with instruction tuning alone. The full recipe improves over the base model by an average of 11.33 accuracy points across twelve benchmarks. These results show that supervision derived from images can build the visual skills needed for interleaved reasoning and improve learning from task-specific demonstrations.
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

ru.title: Картинки сами учат модель думать глазами
ru.desc: В статье предлагается двухэтапный метод обучения мультимодальных LLM, в котором модель учится рассуждать, чередуя текст и изображения. На первом этапе используются визуальные претекст-задачи, например колоризация и шумоподавление, где модель описывает искажённое изображение, генерирует восстановленное и интерпретирует результат. На втором этапе применяется instruction tuning на автоматически созданных демонстрациях. Метод при том же бюджете обучения превосходит обычный instruction tuning и даёт в среднем +11.33 пункта точности на двенадцати бенчмарках.

en.title: Teach models to reason with images—using images themselves as supervision
en.desc: ThinkMorph-SSL trains multimodal models in two stages to improve visual reasoning. First, visual pretext tasks such as colorization and denoising teach models to describe images, generate restored images, and interpret the results as interleaved reasoning traces. Next, automatically created demonstrations are used for question-driven instruction tuning. This approach outperforms instruction tuning alone and raises average accuracy by 11.33 points across twelve benchmarks.

zh.title: 让图像成为监督信号，教模型图文交错推理
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出 ThinkMorph-SSL，一种让多模态模型学会交替使用文字和图像进行推理的两阶段训练方法。第一阶段把图像着色、去噪等视觉预训练任务转化为推理过程：模型先描述图像，再生成修复后的图像，最后解释结果。第二阶段利用自动构建的示范数据进行指令微调，减少对人工任务示范的依赖。在相同的指令微调训练预算下，该方法优于单独进行指令微调；完整方案在十二个基准测试上的平均准确率比基础模型提高了 11.33 个百分点。

papers.title: RoMo Hands: A Large Scale Richly Organized Text to Hand Motion Dataset
papers.abstract: Abstract A large-scale text-paired dataset of bimanual hand motion, paired with a 393-D representation and benchmark, enables systematic evaluation of generative models for dexterous motion synthesis.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash While text-driven body motion generation has matured, pure-hand synthesis remains bottlenecked by data. Existing datasets often treat hands as rigid end-effectors, lack fine-grained captions, or are too limited in scale to support robust generalization. We introduce RoMo Hands, an in-the-wild, text-paired dataset of ~542K sequences (884 hours, 95.5M frames at 30 fps) which is an order of magnitude larger than prior work. To ensure high-quality supervision, a stringent dexterity filter discards low-articulation sequences, focusing the distribution on complex bimanual movement. Each clip is paired with five captions at increasing granularities from global semantic tags to atomic finger states, organized under a hierarchical taxonomy. To bridge the gap between body and hand architectures, we propose a novel 393-D bimanual representation that adapts redundant body-motion paradigms to the high-DoF kinematics of hands. Systematic benchmarking of diffusion, masked-token, and autoregressive generators reveals distinct trade-offs under these hand-specific adaptations, including a sharp divergence between semantic alignment and kinematic plausibility. Our dataset, representation, and benchmark establish a rigorous foundation for the next generation of dexterous motion synthesis. Project page: https://romodataset.github.io/romo-hands/.

ru.title: Большой датасет открывает путь к ловкой генерации движений кистей
ru.desc: В статье представлен RoMo Hands — крупный датасет текст-движение для двуручных движений кистей, содержащий около 542 тысяч последовательностей (884 часа) с пятью иерархическими описаниями на каждый клип. Авторы вводят 393-мерное представление двуручного движения, адаптированное под высокую степень свободы кистей, и отфильтровывают малоподвижные последовательности с помощью строгого фильтра ловкости. Систематический бенчмарк диффузионных моделей, masked-token и autoregressive генераторов показывает различия в компромиссах между семантическим соответствием текста и кинематической правдоподобностью. Работа закладывает основу для генерации ловких движений кистей, которая до сих пор была ограничена нехваткой данных.

en.title: A richer foundation for dexterous hand motion from text
en.desc: RoMo Hands is a large dataset for generating hand movements from text, with about 542,000 motion sequences and 884 hours of video. Each sequence has five captions at different levels of detail, and a filtering step prioritizes complex two-hand movements. The paper also introduces a 393-dimensional representation of bimanual hand motion and benchmarks diffusion, masked-token, and autoregressive models. The results show that models can differ in how well their motions match the text and how physically plausible their hand movements are.

zh.title: 以大规模数据与精细表示，推动灵巧双手动作生成
zh.desc: 论文提出 RoMo Hands，这是一个大规模的双手动作文本配对数据集，包含约 54.2 万段动作序列。每段动作配有五种不同细致程度的文字描述，并通过灵巧度筛选重点保留复杂的双手动作。研究还设计了 393 维双手动作表示，以刻画手部丰富的关节运动。基准测试比较了扩散模型、掩码令牌模型和自回归模型，发现文字语义匹配与动作在运动学上的合理性之间存在明显差异。

papers.title: Interpretable Prototype-Conditioned Adaptation for Weather Forecasting
papers.abstract: Abstract Group-specific prototype banks with cross-variable attention and sparse low-rank corrections improve the accuracy and interpretability of neural weather forecasting by explicitly linking local prototype contributions to prediction errors.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Data-driven weather forecasting requires distinguishing local states and their temporal evolution. However, learned patterns remain implicit in neural forecasters, making their influence difficult to interpret. Failing to distinguish local evolution can lead to similar forecasts for locations that develop differently, increasing prediction error. This motivates explicit references for distinguishing and interpreting local patterns. Prototypes provide explicit pattern references, but sample- or task-level conditioning leaves open how to adapt to distinct locations and variable groups. To deal with this problem, we design ProtoCast, which uses group-specific prototype banks to adapt local features while accounting for cross-variable dependencies. Specifically, (1) we combine each group's historical features and temporal change with forecast context from cross-variable attention for evolution-aware prototype matching. (2) Sparse mixtures of prototype-specific low-rank operators tailor corrections to each group and location. A gated attention block then exchanges the corrected features across groups before prediction. Each group's correction decomposes into explicit prototype contributions before this fusion. (3) We jointly train the forecasting network and operators from scratch and refit each group's prototypes before every training epoch. Slot tracking preserves prototype-operator associations, making each prototype's contribution to local corrections more interpretable. Experiments on GlobalForecast and TyphoonTracking show improved forecasting accuracy, while prototype deletion links local feature contributions to changes in prediction error. This work advances the development of more accurate and interpretable data-driven weather forecasting models. Project page: https://zhixuanli.github.io/projects/li2026protocast
affiliations: Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology, China

ru.title: Прототипы погоды: точнее прогноз и понятное объяснение каждого вклада
ru.desc: В статье представлен ProtoCast — модель для прогнозирования погоды на основе данных, которая использует групповые банки прототипов (prototype banks), специфичные для каждой группы переменных. Прототипы сопоставляются с признаками, историей и временными изменениями с учётом контекста из cross-variable attention, что позволяет учитывать эволюцию локальных состояний. Для коррекций применяются разреженные смеси low-rank операторов, а затем gated attention объединяет скорректированные признаки между группами перед предсказанием. Благодаря slot tracking и удалению прототипов удаётся связать вклад каждого прототипа с изменением ошибки прогноза, что повышает и точность, и интерпретируемость модели.

en.title: Weather Forecasts Made Clearer with Local Prototypes
en.desc: ProtoCast improves neural weather forecasting with separate prototype banks for different variable groups. It matches local historical patterns and their temporal evolution to prototypes, using cross-variable attention to include forecast context. Sparse mixtures of low-rank operators then apply group- and location-specific corrections, whose prototype contributions can be inspected before features are combined for prediction. Experiments show better forecast accuracy, and deleting prototypes reveals how their contributions affect prediction error.

zh.title: 让天气预报有据可循：用专属原型提升准确度与可解释性
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出 ProtoCast，一种用于数据驱动天气预报的神经网络模型，目标是提升预测准确度和可解释性。模型为不同变量组建立专属原型库，并结合历史特征、时间变化和跨变量注意力信息，匹配适合的局部天气模式。随后，模型用稀疏混合的低秩算子修正各组和各地点的特征，再通过门控注意力融合不同变量组的信息。实验显示，ProtoCast 在多个数据集上提高了预报表现；删除原型的测试也能揭示各原型对局部修正及预测误差的影响。

papers.title: EEGJev: A System One Decision Model and Benchmark for Multi-Task EEG Question Answering
papers.abstract: Abstract  A single electroencephalographic (EEG) recording can support multiple decoding tasks. Fixed-label tests cannot show how EEG foundation models handle changing questions or options. We introduce EEGJev, a fast decision model that scores candidate answers in one pass. Our benchmark, EEGJev-Bench, covers six question types across 19 public EEG sources. We held the recording and options fixed while switching between questions about attributes paired during training, such as facial expression and the hand participants were asked to use. Across 13 test sources, EEGJev selected a label for the requested attribute with 99.70% accuracy (49.20% under uniform choice). Balanced accuracy for the specific answer was 62.04%. Its 95th-percentile response time was shorter than NeuroLM's on matched validation questions answered individually. EEGJev lets users switch decoding targets by changing the question. With EEGJev-Bench, researchers can test whether new decoders follow the question more reliably, identify the correct answer more often, or both.
affiliations: Unprecedented-scale Data Analytics Center, Tohoku University, Sendai, Japan

ru.title: Один сигнал мозга, много вопросов: декодируем ЭЭГ под любую задачу
ru.desc: В статье представлена модель EEGJev, которая по одной ЭЭГ-записи отвечает на разные вопросы, выбирая ответ из набора вариантов за один проход. Для оценки создан бенчмарк EEGJev-Bench, охватывающий шесть типов вопросов и 19 публичных EEG-источников. Тестирование показало точность выбора нужного атрибута 99,70% при случайном уровне 49,20%, а сбалансированная точность конкретного ответа составила 62,04%. Модель работает быстрее NeuroLM по 95-му перцентилю времени ответа, а бенчмарк позволяет проверять, насколько точно декодер следует формулировке вопроса и верно ли определяет правильный ответ.

en.title: One EEG recording, many questions—decode the answer you ask for
en.desc: The paper introduces EEGJev, a fast decision model that scores candidate answers in one pass from an EEG recording. Unlike fixed-label tests, EEGJev-Bench evaluates whether a model can change its decoding target when the question changes, across six question types and 19 public EEG sources. EEGJev chose the requested attribute’s label with 99.70% accuracy, while its balanced accuracy for identifying the specific answer was 62.04%; its 95th-percentile response time was also shorter than NeuroLM’s on matched questions. The benchmark helps researchers assess whether EEG decoders follow questions reliably and select correct answers.

zh.title: 换个问题，解码不同脑电信息
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出 EEGJev，一种快速决策模型，可在一次计算中为多个候选答案打分。研究者还构建了 EEGJev-Bench，涵盖 19 个公开 EEG 数据源和六类问题，用来评估模型能否根据问题切换解码目标。实验中，模型在 13 个测试数据源上选中问题所指属性的准确率为 99.70%，具体答案的平衡准确率为 62.04%，响应速度也优于对照方法 NeuroLM。研究表明，用户只需更换问题就能指定解码目标，而该基准有助于检验模型是否真正遵循问题并找出正确答案。

papers.title: Do learned image captioning metrics generalize? Auditing duplicated samples in human-judgment benchmarks
papers.abstract: Abstract An audit of recent image captioning evaluation benchmarks shows that duplicate samples and metric behavior inflate reported correlations, and proposes a protocol under which zero-shot vision-language judges perform best on recent test sets.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Learned image captioning metrics are trained and tested on human judgments, so their reported correlation is a claim about generalization. We audit this claim for the three most recent collections of such judgments, Polaris, Nebula, and Spica, matching images at the pixel level. First, test samples reappear in training sets: the Spica training set contains about two-thirds of the Polaris test set, with identical human ratings. Second, controlled retraining shows that duplicates can inflate a metric: for Pearl, the gain is confined to the duplicated samples and grows with every epoch; for DENEB, it stays below one point. The gain depends on the learner and on how often a training set repeats a sample. Third, Kendall's τ over all samples is the sum of two terms, detecting captions with the lowest human score and ranking the others; the first supplies most of the reported correlation and is nearly saturated. The recent test sets cannot order Polos, DENEB and Pearl consistently, and a ridge regression on frozen features matches or exceeds all three. Fourth, we propose a protocol that ranks a learned metric only with a model trained without test samples, reports both terms, and compares metrics by paired tests. Under it, zero-shot vision--language judges rank first on the three recent test sets, and a fine-tuned judge ranks first on the three earlier benchmarks. The same analysis applies to any evaluator learned from human judgments; filter lists and code are released at https://github.com/morninghut/ic-dataset-audit .
affiliations: School of Artificial Intelligence and Computer Science, Shaanxi Normal University

ru.title: Дубликаты и насыщенные тесты завышают качество метрик описаний изображений
ru.desc: Статья проводит аудит современных бенчмарков для оценки описаний изображений (image captioning), основанных на человеческих оценках, и показывает, что дубликаты между обучающей и тестовой выборками завышают результаты learned metrics. Авторы выделяют два компонента корреляции Кендалла τ: обнаружение наихудших описаний и ранжирование остальных, причём первый почти насыщен и даёт основной вклад в итоговую цифру. Простая ridge regression на замороженных признаках не уступает современным метрикам, а zero-shot vision-language judges оказываются лучшими на новых тестовых наборах. Предложенный протокол требует обучения без тестовых примеров, раздельного отчёта обоих компонентов и сравнения метрик через paired tests.

en.title: Clean Tests, Clearer Caption Metrics
en.desc: This paper audits image-captioning metrics trained on human judgments and finds that duplicate images across training and test sets can make reported generalization look better than it is. The effect varies by metric and training process, and much of Kendall’s τ correlation comes from identifying captions with the lowest human scores rather than ranking the rest. The authors also find that recent test sets do not consistently rank learned metrics, while a simple ridge-regression baseline can match or outperform them. They propose evaluating models without test-set overlap, reporting both parts of Kendall’s τ, and using paired statistical tests; under this protocol, zero-shot vision-language judges perform best on recent test sets.

zh.title: 清除重复样本，才能公平评估图像描述指标
zh.desc: 本文审查图像描述评测基准中学习型指标的泛化能力，并逐像素匹配图像以发现训练集与测试集之间的重复样本。实验显示，重复数据可能抬高部分指标的相关性，但影响大小取决于学习方法和样本重复次数。作者还指出，Kendall τ 的总体分数很大程度来自识别人工评分最低的描述，而这一部分的表现已接近饱和，因此单一相关性分数可能掩盖指标差异。论文提出更严格的比较协议：排除测试样本参与训练，分别报告两类评分表现，并使用配对检验；按此协议，零样本视觉语言评判器在近期测试集上表现最佳。

papers.title: Escriba-OCR: A 1B Vision-Language Model for Error-Preserving Transcription of Handwritten Portuguese Essays
papers.abstract: Abstract  Feedback tools and research on learner writing need transcriptions of handwritten essays that keep exactly what the student wrote: misspellings, line breaks, struck-through words and insertions. Vision-language models (VLMs) read handwriting well, but they also tend to rewrite it into correct language. We measure this on BRESSAY, 1,000 handwritten Brazilian Portuguese essays, with a benchmark that adds error preservation, invented errors, edit-markup precision and recall and line structure to the character error rate (CER) and uses paired bootstrap confidence intervals. We restrict the study to open-weight models that schools can run on their own hardware. Of 22 open baselines, the best, Qwen3-VL 235B-A22B, reaches 5.6% CER on the 199 test pages; none reproduces the edit markup reliably, and every VLM replaces 39-78% of the words absent from a Portuguese dictionary with dictionary words. We fine-tune LightOnOCR-3-1B on the 647 training pages in 85 minutes on one GPU. The resulting Escriba-OCR-1B reaches 2.06% CER, 3.5 points below the best baseline (95% CI [-4.2, -2.9]); under the ICDAR 2024 competition metric it reaches 2.1% CER, below the best published page-level results (2.2-2.4%). It recovers 67% of insertions and 77% of illegible deletions, and reproduces the line structure of 97% of the pages, but still normalises 60% of likely misspellings. Three seeds agree within 0.04 CER points, and quantised to 4 bits the model runs on an ordinary CPU at about one minute per page. On 40 letters of another corpus it matches its base model (without that model's appended comments) but misreads unseen words more often; weight interpolation recovers half the gap. A teacher's review finds that 45% of the judgeable apparent corrections are errors in the BRESSAY ground truth, so dictionary-based scores likely understate preservation. We release the model, the benchmark code and the review data.
affiliations: Federal Institute of São Paulo (IFSP), Brazil

ru.title: Распознавать рукопись точно, а не переписывать её заново
ru.desc: Авторы исследуют, как vision-language модели (VLM) распознают рукописные эссе на бразильском португальском: большие модели склонны «исправлять» орфографию и переписывать текст, а не передавать его точно. Они создали бенчмарк BRESSAY из 1000 эссе с метриками сохранения ошибок, правок и структуры строк, и показали, что лучшая открытая модель Qwen3-VL даёт CER 5,6%. Дообучив компактную модель LightOnOCR-3-1B на 647 страницах за 85 минут на одном GPU, они получили Escriba-OCR-1B с CER 2,06%, которая работает даже на обычном CPU. Работа также показывает, что часть «ошибок» в эталонной разметке на самом деле является ошибками разметки, поэтому словарные метрики могут занижать качество сохранения текста.

en.title: Transcribe the Writing—Don’t Rewrite It
en.desc: This paper evaluates open-weight vision-language models (VLMs) for transcribing handwritten Brazilian Portuguese essays while preserving student errors, edits, and line breaks. The strongest baseline achieves 5.6% character error rate (CER), but all tested VLMs often normalize misspellings and fail to reproduce edit markup reliably. Fine-tuning a 1-billion-parameter OCR model produces Escriba-OCR-1B, which reaches 2.06% CER and preserves line structure on 97% of test pages, though it still corrects many likely misspellings. The model runs on ordinary CPUs when quantized, and the authors release it alongside benchmark code and review data.

zh.title: 转写手写原文，不替学生纠错
zh.desc: 本文研究如何准确转写巴西葡萄牙语手写作文，并保留拼写错误、换行、删除线和插入内容，而不是自动改写成规范语言。作者在包含1,000篇作文的BRESSAY数据集上评测22个可本地运行的开源视觉语言模型，并设计指标衡量错误保留、误造错误、编辑标记和行结构。研究者用647页训练数据微调一个小型OCR模型Escriba-OCR-1B，使字符错误率达到2.06%，优于基线模型；量化到4位后，它还能在普通CPU上运行。模型能较好恢复插入内容和行结构，但仍会把许多疑似拼写错误改成词典中的正确词，而且人工复核发现部分基准答案本身也有错误。
